items.title: 盧比歐將與巴西外長會談！川普准波索納洛赴美避風頭升高美巴緊張
items.title_en: Rubio to Meet Brazil's Foreign Minister! Trump Sends Bolsonaro to U.S., Raising U.S.-Brazil Tensions
paras: 美國國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）與巴西外交部長已同意在未來幾週內舉行會談。知情人士表示，美國總統川普決定讓巴西落敗的右翼候選人弗拉維奧・波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）赴美尋求庇護，引發兩國緊張關係升高，促成這次會談安排。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士透露，盧比歐與維埃拉週五（30日）在亞特蘭大舉行的G20外長會議期間短暫會面，雙方同意在12月G20峰會登場前再次會談。
今年12月的G20峰會預計由川普在其名下的川普國家多羅高爾夫俱樂部（Trump National Doral Golf Club）主持。本週在喬治亞州舉行的部長級會議，旨在為這場峰會預作準備。
川普本週稍早批准波索納洛赴美。波索納洛在週日的巴西選舉中敗給左翼領袖、現任總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva），目前在巴西至少面臨兩項聯邦調查，涉及洗錢指控。
波索納洛獲美國國務院核發簽證後，週三宣稱將在美國領導反對魯拉的陣營，並指控選舉存在舞弊，但未提出任何證據。
川普表示，他之所以允許這名敗選候選人赴美，是因為巴西選舉「糟糕透頂」且「遭到操縱」，此外，他也強調自己「非常熟悉」波索納洛的父親、巴西前總統雅伊爾・波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）。
雅伊爾・波索納洛是川普的盟友，曾於2019年至2023年擔任巴西總統，目前因參與策劃政變未遂、企圖在2022年大選後阻止魯拉就任，而正在服刑，刑期為27年。
去年，美國曾對巴西實施強硬關稅措施，試圖協助雅伊爾・波索納洛避免入獄。此後，兩國關係一直起伏不定，儘管雙方在貿易方面已取得一些進展。
另一方面，巴西當局已召見阿根廷駐巴西最高外交代表，要求其說明阿根廷總統米雷伊（Javier Milei）在協助波索納洛逃離巴西一事中扮演的角色。波索納洛週二晚間越境前往鄰國阿根廷，隨後搭乘飛往美國的班機。

paras_en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s foreign minister have agreed to hold talks in the coming weeks, sources said. The move follows President Donald Trump’s decision to allow right‑wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost in Brazil, to seek refuge in the United States, heightening tensions between the two countries and prompting the meeting arrangement.

According to Bloomberg, sources said Rubio and Brazil’s foreign minister Vieira met briefly on Friday (the 30th) during the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta and agreed to reconvene before the G20 summit in December.
The December G20 summit is expected to be hosted by Trump at his Trump National Doral Golf Club. This week’s ministerial meeting in Georgia was intended to lay the groundwork for that summit.

Trump earlier this week approved Bolsonaro’s travel to the United States. Bolsonaro lost Sunday’s Brazilian election to left‑wing leader and incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and now faces at least two federal investigations in Brazil, including money‑laundering allegations.
After receiving a visa from the U.S. State Department, Bolsonaro said on Wednesday he would lead a U.S.‑based campaign against Lula and claimed the election was rigged, though he offered no evidence.

Trump said he allowed the defeated candidate to come to the U.S. because Brazil’s election was “a disaster” and “manipulated,” adding that he is “very familiar” with Bolsonaro’s father, former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro.

Jair Bolsonaro, a Trump ally who served as Brazil’s president from 2019 to 2023, is currently serving a 27‑year sentence for plotting a coup attempt and trying to block Lula’s inauguration after the 2022 election.

Last year the United States imposed tough tariffs on Brazil in an effort to help Jair Bolsonaro avoid prison. Relations between the two countries have since been volatile, though some trade progress has been made.

Meanwhile, Brazilian authorities have summoned Argentina’s top diplomatic representative in Brazil to demand an explanation of Argentine President Javier Milei’s role in helping Flávio Bolsonaro flee Brazil. Bolsonaro crossed into Argentina on Tuesday night before boarding a flight to the United States.

items.title: 亞馬遜未來支出承諾飆至8836億美元 新增800億美元融資額度支援AI擴張
items.title_en: Amazon’s Future Spending Commitment Soars to $883.581 Billion, Adds $80 Billion Financing Facility to Support AI Expansion
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資持續擴大的同時，正面臨日益沉重的資金壓力。根據公司最新提交給美國證券交易委員會(SEC)的第三季文件，截至2026年9月底，亞馬遜未來合約支出承諾總額已攀升至8,835.81億美元，較前一季增加36%，更是2025年同期的兩倍以上。為支應資料中心及AI硬體採購，公司也新增最高800億美元的供應商融資貸款額度，進一步擴大籌資管道。
這項融資安排允許亞馬遜自行決定是否動用資金，期間自2027年第一季起至2028年第三季止，貸款期限則從每筆實際借款日起算，最長為5年，利率採浮動利率。作為擔保，亞馬遜將針對部分透過融資安排購買的資產提供擔保權益，相關未償還金額將列入公司資產負債表的長期債務。
不過，800億美元只是可使用的融資上限，並非亞馬遜已經借入的金額，公司也沒有承諾一定會動用全部額度。文件並未揭露具體哪些採購資產將作為擔保，也未公布參與貸款的金融機構及實際融資利率。
亞馬遜雲端運算部門Amazon Web Services (AWS)執行長馬特·加曼(Matt Garman)周五(30日)接受《彭博電視》訪問時表示，當公司看到眼前存在如此龐大的機會，就會尋找負責任的融資方式，以便盡可能擴大對客戶的服務規模。他也指出，隨著公司積極加速投資，亞馬遜正與合作夥伴研究如何平衡相關現金流。
過去，亞馬遜主要依靠雲端運算、零售等業務產生的營運現金流，以及大規模發行公司債，支應資料中心建設與晶片採購。此次新增供應商融資安排，則讓公司可以針對技術基礎設施採購取得額外資金，降低所有投資支出都由自身現金流承擔的壓力。

亞馬遜截至9月底的8,835.81億美元合約支出承諾，涵蓋範圍相當廣泛，並不等同於目前已經背負的有息債務，也不代表所有款項都必須在短期內支付。根據公司文件，這些承諾包括長期債務本金與利息2,942.54億美元、尚未開始的租約1,649.22億美元、不動產及設備採購承諾1,596.40億美元、營運租賃負債1,214.92億美元、無條件採購義務947.59億美元、融資租賃負債179.55億美元、融資義務115.65億美元，以及其他承諾189.94億美元。
其中，尚未開始的租約及不動產、設備採購承諾，反映亞馬遜為未來資料中心與技術基礎設施擴張所預留的資源。這些支出將隨著相關設施啟用及採購交付逐步轉化為實際付款義務，也使公司未來數年的資金需求更加龐大。
第三季財報進一步顯示，亞馬遜的AI投資已明顯推高資本支出。公司第三季現金資本支出達759億美元，遠高於2025年同期的342億美元；今年前9個月累計達1,722億美元，也大幅超過去年同期的899億美元。亞馬遜維持2026年全年現金資本支出約2,200億美元的預估，並預期2027年支出將進一步顯著增加，主要由技術基礎設施投資帶動。
資本支出快速增加，也使自由現金流由正轉負。亞馬遜截至2026年9月的過去12個月，自由現金流為負423.57億美元，與2025年同期正147.88億美元相比，減少約571億美元。同期營運現金流則由1,306.91億美元增加至1,683億美元，顯示核心業務仍持續創造現金，但設備與基礎設施投資的增幅更大，抵銷了營運現金流成長。
從資產負債表來看，亞馬遜截至9月底持有現金、約當現金及有價證券合計1,142億美元，低於2025年底的1,230億美元；長期債務則由去年底的656.48億美元升至1,731.25億美元，增加逾一倍。公司第三季營運現金流為424.22億美元，高於去年同期的355.25億美元，但大量資金仍持續投入資本支出及其他投資。
儘管現金流承受壓力，亞馬遜的雲端業務仍展現強勁成長。第三季AWS營收達459.84億美元，年增39%，高於去年同期的330.06億美元；營業利益則由114.34億美元升至177.73億美元。AWS營收成長速度加快，是亞馬遜持續擴大AI資料中心與技術基礎設施投資的重要支撐。
亞馬遜第三季合併營收為2,019.44億美元，年增12%；營業利益280.76億美元，高於去年同期的174.22億美元；淨利則為206.85億美元，略低於去年同期的211.87億美元。從業務結構來看，AWS營收占公司總營收比重已由去年同期的18%升至23%，雲端業務的重要性持續提高。
亞馬遜此次新增800億美元融資額度，反映AI基礎設施競賽已不只是技術與市場需求之爭，也逐漸成為資金調度及資產負債表管理的考驗。公司雖然仍擁有強勁的營運現金流，AWS成長也提供持續投資的商業基礎，但自由現金流轉負、長期債務攀升及未來合約支出承諾快速擴大，都意味著AI擴張需要更複雜的融資安排。
對投資人而言，關鍵不僅是亞馬遜能否持續擴建資料中心、取得晶片與運算資源，更在於這些投資能否轉化為足夠的AWS營收、營業利益及長期自由現金流。若AI需求持續強勁，龐大資本支出可能成為鞏固雲端市場地位的基礎；但若投資回收速度不如預期，快速增加的債務與長期支出承諾，也可能成為未來財務彈性的負擔。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is expanding its AI infrastructure investments while facing mounting financing pressure. According to the company’s latest third‑quarter filing with the U.S. SEC, as of the end of September 2026 the total amount of future contract spending commitments rose to $883.581 billion, up 36% from the prior quarter and more than double the level at the same time in 2025. To fund data‑center and AI‑hardware purchases, the company also added a new supplier‑financing loan facility of up to $80 billion, further widening its funding sources.

The financing arrangement allows Amazon to decide whether to draw down funds, covering the period from Q1 2027 through Q3 2028, with each loan’s term measured from the actual borrowing date and capped at a maximum of five years at a floating interest rate. As collateral, Amazon will grant security interests in certain assets purchased through the facility, and the outstanding amounts will be recorded as long‑term debt on the balance sheet.

However, the $80 billion is merely the ceiling of usable financing, not an amount already borrowed, and the company has not committed to using the full limit. The filing does not disclose which purchased assets will serve as collateral, nor does it name the lending institutions or the actual financing rates.

Matt Garman, chief executive of Amazon Web Services (AWS), told Bloomberg Television on Friday the 30th that when the company sees such a massive opportunity it looks for responsible financing methods to expand service capacity for customers as much as possible. He added that as Amazon accelerates its investments, it is working with partners to balance the related cash flows.

Historically, Amazon has relied on operating cash flow from its cloud and retail businesses and large corporate bond issuances to fund data‑center construction and chip purchases. The new supplier‑financing arrangement gives the company additional capital for technology‑infrastructure procurement, reducing the pressure of funding all investments solely from its own cash flow.

Amazon’s $883.581 billion contract‑spending commitment as of September‑end covers a broad range of items and is not equivalent to existing interest‑bearing debt, nor does it mean all amounts must be paid in the short term. The commitments include $294.254 billion of long‑term debt principal and interest, $164.922 billion of leases not yet commenced, $159.640 billion of real‑estate and equipment purchase commitments, $121.492 billion of operating lease liabilities, $94.759 billion of unconditional purchase obligations, $17.955 billion of finance‑lease liabilities, $11.565 billion of financing obligations, and $18.994 billion of other commitments.

The not‑yet‑commenced leases and real‑estate/equipment purchase commitments reflect resources set aside for future data‑center and technology‑infrastructure expansion. These expenditures will gradually turn into actual payment obligations as facilities are activated and deliveries made, further enlarging Amazon’s funding needs for the coming years.

The third‑quarter results show that Amazon’s AI investments have markedly lifted capital expenditures. Capital spending in Q3 reached $75.9 billion, far above $34.2 billion in the same quarter of 2025; for the first nine months of the year it totaled $172.2 billion, also well above $89.9 billion a year earlier. Amazon maintains its 2026 full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook of roughly $220 billion and expects 2027 spending to rise further, driven mainly by technology‑infrastructure investment.

The rapid rise in capex has turned free cash flow negative. Over the twelve months ending September 2026, Amazon’s free cash flow was a negative $42.357 billion, down about $57.1 billion from the positive $14.788 billion in the comparable 2025 period. Operating cash flow in the same span grew from $130.691 billion to $168.3 billion, showing the core business still generates cash, but the surge in equipment and infrastructure spending more than offsets that growth.

From the balance sheet, Amazon held $114.2 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at September‑end, down from $123.0 billion at the end of 2025. Long‑term debt rose from $65.648 billion at the end of last year to $173.125 billion, more than doubling. Third‑quarter operating cash flow was $42.422 billion, up from $35.525 billion a year earlier, yet large sums continue to be deployed to capex and other investments.

Despite cash‑flow pressure, Amazon’s cloud business remains strong. AWS revenue in Q3 was $45.984 billion, up 39% year‑over‑year, versus $33.006 billion a year ago; operating income rose from $11.434 billion to $17.773 billion. The accelerating AWS revenue growth underpins Amazon’s ongoing expansion of AI data centers and technology‑infrastructure spending.

Amazon’s consolidated Q3 revenue was $201.944 billion, up 12% year‑over‑year; operating income was $28.076 billion, higher than $17.422 billion a year earlier; net income was $20.685 billion, slightly below $21.187 billion in the prior year. AWS now accounts for 23% of total revenue, up from 18% a year ago, reflecting the growing importance of the cloud segment.

The new $80 billion financing facility highlights that the AI‑infrastructure race is no longer just about technology and market demand but also about capital allocation and balance‑sheet management. While Amazon still enjoys strong operating cash flow and AWS growth provides a solid investment base, the shift to negative free cash flow, rising long‑term debt and rapidly expanding contract‑spending commitments indicate that AI expansion will require increasingly complex financing structures.

For investors, the key question is not only whether Amazon can keep building data centers, securing chips and compute capacity, but also whether those investments translate into sufficient AWS revenue, operating profit and long‑term free cash flow. If AI demand stays robust, the massive capex could cement its cloud market position; however, if investment pay‑back lags, the swiftly growing debt and long‑term spending commitments could strain future financial flexibility.

items.title: OpenAI大砍募資目標100億美元！估值降至1.25兆美元、投資人縮減認購
items.title_en: OpenAI Slashes Funding Goal by $10 Billion, Valuation Cut to $1.25 Trillion as Investors Trim Commitments
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮面臨市場重新評價之際，OpenAI傳出下修最新一輪募資目標，募資規模較原定計畫減少100億美元，目標估值也從1.4兆美元降至1.25兆美元。
根據《金融時報》週五（30日）引述知情人士報導，ChatGPT開發商OpenAI目前尋求募資約200億美元，並已設定週五為投資人承諾參與本輪募資的截止日。
不過，由於部分投資人縮減認購額度，預計首輪交割實際募得金額將低於200億美元。
《金融時報》補充，包含阿拉伯聯合大公國政府支持的科技基金MGX在內的一個阿聯投資人財團，預計將成為本輪募資的最大參與者。作為交易的一部分，OpenAI將取得選擇權，可租用該地區新開發的運算資源。
此外，創投機構Founders Fund、Coatue、紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）及Andreessen Horowitz預計也將參與投資。
《金融時報》另指出，富裕個人投資者將有機會在後續的散戶發行計畫中，以1.25兆美元的估值投資OpenAI。
隨著市場對AI龐大支出的疑慮升高，美國科技股近期遭遇重挫。科技股比重較高的那斯達克指數週五下跌約2.9%，較10月6日創下的歷史收盤高點下跌7.8%。
《路透》先前報導，正計畫於2027年上市的OpenAI，積極尋求盡快完成本輪募資，部分原因是希望搶在Anthropic即將上市前完成交易，因為兩家公司鎖定的投資人群體相近。
paras_en: Amid a market re‑assessment of the AI investment boom, OpenAI has reportedly lowered its latest fundraising target, reducing the size of the round by $10 billion and cutting the target valuation from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

According to the Financial Times on Friday (the 30th), which cited sources familiar with the matter, ChatGPT developer OpenAI is now seeking roughly $20 billion in funding and has set Friday as the deadline for investors to commit to the round.
However, because some investors are scaling back their subscriptions, the amount actually raised in the first closing is expected to fall short of the $20 billion target.

The FT added that a consortium of UAE investors, including the government‑backed technology fund MGX, is expected to be the largest participant in the round. As part of the deal, OpenAI will obtain an option to lease newly built compute capacity in the region.
In addition, venture‑capital firms Founders Fund, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also slated to invest.
The FT also noted that wealthy individual investors will have the chance to invest in OpenAI in a later retail‑issuance program at the $1.25 trillion valuation.

As concerns grow over the massive spending required for AI, U.S. tech stocks have recently taken a sharp hit. The Nasdaq, which is heavily weighted toward tech, fell about 2.9% on Friday, a 7.8% drop from the all‑time closing high set on October 6.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI, which plans to go public in 2027, is pushing to close this round quickly, partly to complete the transaction before Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, since the two companies target largely overlapping investor bases.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉東捷資訊搭資安題材 逆勢續漲近2成創近1年新高價
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Dongjie Information Leverages Cybersecurity Theme to Rise Nearly 20% Against the Trend, Hits One‑Year High
paras: 資訊軟體服務商東捷資訊 (6697-TW) 本周股價再度大漲，並未受大盤重挫的衝擊，走出自己的路，周漲幅高達18%，合計二周來漲幅近30%，最高來到去年11月中旬以來高點，反映資安題材。
由於全球資安問題擴大，近期全球約70%網站運作的開源程式語言 PHP 被揭露存在兩項高危險性安全漏洞，資安議題再度受市場關注。
東捷資訊表示，攜手國際頂尖資安原廠建立夥伴關係，提供從事前資安盤點、檢測，到事中監控與事後支援的全方位服務，可協助企業將傳統被動防禦，升級為主動阻斷威脅的零信任顧問服務。
目前東捷資訊ERP建置案穩步推進，數據治理等智慧應用也陸續導入客戶場域並開始上線，同時優化產品組合。
東捷資訊上半年已完成鋼鐵製造大廠、電動車零組件製造大廠和 AI 技術軟體公司等多項 SAP 雲端 ERP 建置專案，並為國內知名醫療院所導入供應商交期管理系統，成功將業務拓展至醫療產業。
paras_en: Information software service provider Dongjie Information (6697‑TW) saw its stock surge again this week, shrugging off the market’s broad decline and carving its own path. The weekly gain hit 18%, bringing the two‑week rise to nearly 30% and pushing the price to its highest level since mid‑November last year, reflecting the cybersecurity theme.

As global cybersecurity concerns grow, two high‑severity vulnerabilities have been disclosed in PHP—the open‑source programming language that powers roughly 70% of websites worldwide, drawing renewed market attention to security issues.

Dongjie Information said it has partnered with leading international cybersecurity vendors to offer end‑to‑end services—from pre‑emptive security assessments and testing to real‑time monitoring and post‑incident support—helping enterprises upgrade from traditional passive defenses to proactive, zero‑trust threat‑blocking consulting services.

Its ERP implementation projects are progressing steadily, and smart applications such as data governance are being gradually rolled out at customer sites and going live, while the company continues to optimize its product portfolio.

In the first half of the year, Dongjie Information completed several SAP cloud ERP projects for major steel manufacturers, electric‑vehicle component makers and AI software firms, and also deployed a supplier delivery‑date management system for a well‑known domestic medical institution, successfully expanding its business into the healthcare sector.

items.title: 標普砍Meta信評展望至「負向」！AI支出失與現金流惡化引發擔憂
items.title_en: S&P Cuts Meta's Credit Outlook to "Negative" Over AI Spending and Deteriorating Cash Flow
paras: 標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)周五(30日)將Meta Platforms(META-US)的信用評等展望從「穩定」調降至「負向」，理由是這家社群媒體巨頭的資本支出與自由營運現金流前景存在重大不確定性。
標普表示，Meta的槓桿比率最早可能在2027年升至一倍以上。槓桿比率是債務相對於獲利的指標，而標普全球評級對「AA-」發行人信用評等設定的槓桿比率門檻為一倍。
標普指出，相較於同業，Meta將人工智慧(AI)投資轉化為營收的能力較為有限。未來幾年，AI營收來源何時才能產生足以超越成本攀升的重大貢獻，目前仍不明朗。
展望遭降代表Meta目前「AA-」的信評有在兩年內遭調降的風險，但也意味著標普全球目前並未積極考慮砍信評。「AA-」是第四高投資等級，即使被降一
大型科技公司過去長期投入大量資金發展雲端運算、網路廣告及電子商務，但AI熱潮已將資本支出推升至驚人水準，引發投資人擔憂，業者能否及時從相關投資中獲得足夠回報。
Meta上周預估全年資本支出將達1,350億至1,450億美元，在此同時，第3季現金缺口達21.2億美元。Meta也計劃進入公開市場籌資，發行價值975億美元的股票，以支應AI建設。

標普估Meta未來兩年現金流缺口擴大

標普目前預估，Meta自由營運現金流(FOCF)赤字將在2026年達390億美元，2027年進一步擴大至710億美元。
標普表示，龐大支出可能使Meta的自由營運現金流在2028年之後仍持續為負，並預期Meta將完全依靠舉債，填補2028年的現金缺口。
標普指出：「考量Meta未來資本支出的前景仍不明朗，加上AI投資計畫為期多年且極為積極，我們對Meta能否像先前預期那樣控制支出的信心已降低。」
Meta發言人說：「我們尊重但不同意標普對Meta AI變現能力的看法。」並指出，公司認為未來仍有「重大產品與業務機會」，足以支撐非常強健的信用狀況。

Meta槓桿比率攀升 標普警告信用狀況恐持續轉弱

標普表示，Meta的槓桿比率已從2025年的0.1倍上升，主因是Met選擇租用資料中心容量，而非透過發行債務融資。
標普全球評級美國媒體與電信產業主管Naveen Sarma說：「如果資本支出持續維持高檔，且成長速度超過我們的預期，企業信用狀況將持續惡化，現金流也將維持負值。」
截至9月30日，Meta的長期債務為809.2億美元。
標普周四也將博通(AVGO-US)的信評展望從「正向」調降至「穩定」，表示雖然AI業務快速成長，但營運上也更加依賴少數大型客戶。
標普今年稍早則將雲端運算巨頭甲骨文(ORCL-US)的信用評等下調至「BBB-」，只比非投資等級債券的門檻高一級，原因是該公司資產負債表的槓桿程度過高。
paras_en: S&P Global Ratings on Friday the 30th lowered Meta Platforms' (META-US) credit outlook from "Stable" to "Negative," citing significant uncertainty around the social‑media giant's capital spending and free operating cash‑flow outlook.
S&P said Meta's leverage ratio could rise above 1.0 as early as 2027. The leverage ratio measures debt relative to earnings, and S&P sets a 1.0 threshold for issuers rated "AA-".

S&P noted that, compared with peers, Meta's ability to turn AI investments into revenue is relatively limited, and it remains unclear when AI‑derived revenue will be large enough to offset rising costs in the coming years.

The outlook downgrade signals that Meta's "AA-" rating faces a risk of being cut within two years, but it also means S&P is not currently actively considering an outright rating downgrade. "AA-" is the fourth‑highest investment grade, even if it were to be lowered one notch.

Large tech firms have historically poured massive capital into cloud computing, online advertising and e‑commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditures to astonishing levels, raising investor concerns about whether companies can reap sufficient returns in time.

Meta last week projected full‑year capital spending of $135‑$145 billion, while its Q3 cash shortfall reached $2.12 billion. The company also plans to raise funds in the public market, issuing $97.5 billion of stock to finance AI development.
S&P now estimates Meta's free operating cash‑flow deficit will reach $39 billion in 2026 and expand to $71 billion in 2027.
S&P warned that the massive outlays could keep Meta's free operating cash flow negative beyond 2028, and the company is expected to rely entirely on borrowing to fill the 2028 cash gap.

S&P said: "Given the still‑uncertain outlook for Meta's future capital spending and the multi‑year, aggressive AI investment plan, our confidence that Meta can control spending as previously expected has eroded."

A Meta spokesperson said: "We respect but disagree with S&P's view on Meta's AI monetization potential," adding that the company still sees "significant product and business opportunities" sufficient to support a very strong credit profile.
Meta's leverage ratio has risen from 0.1× in 2025, driven mainly by the company's choice to lease data‑center capacity rather than finance it through debt issuance, S&P noted.

S&P Global Ratings U.S. media and telecom sector head Naveen Sarma said: "If capital spending remains high and grows faster than we anticipate, corporate credit quality will continue to deteriorate and cash flow will stay negative."
As of September 30, Meta's long‑term debt stood at $80.92 billion.

S&P also downgraded Broadcom's (AVGO-US) credit outlook on Thursday from "Positive" to "Stable," noting that while its AI business is growing rapidly, operations are becoming more dependent on a few large customers.
Earlier this year S&P cut Oracle's (ORCL-US) credit rating to "BBB-," just one notch above non‑investment‑grade, due to an excessively leveraged balance sheet.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗臺輝達工作站新品與獲利爆發加持 無懼大盤回檔獲外資逆勢買超
items.title_en: Hot Stock: LITEON’s New NVIDIA Workstation Products and Profit Surge Boost, Unfazed by Market Pullback, Foreign Investors Buy Against the Trend
paras: 顯卡暨人工智慧解決方案供應商麗臺(2465-TW)本週在台股大盤面臨崩跌回檔壓力之際，憑藉輝達工作站晶片拉貨暢旺與母集團美超微股價走揚帶動，獲得外資法人逆勢買超力挺。30日雖受大盤大跌拖累回檔亮燈跌停收在102元，外資當日依舊加碼買超659張，並且連續三個交易日站在買方，累計買超達2836張，周漲幅約6%，周成交量4萬張。
財務表現方面，麗臺今年前三季累計營收達73.9億元，年增109.34%。麗臺第三季單季稅後盈餘達3.79億元，較去年同期暴增11.45倍，單季每股稅後純益為4.03元，大幅改寫歷史新高紀錄。
業務動能部分，麗臺受惠經銷代理輝達GB10平台的桌上型超級電腦，以及高階工作站繪圖晶片加速卡今年以來供不應求，加上記憶體價格上漲帶動產品售價顯著調升，成為推升獲利逐季創高的重要引擎。下半年接續推出新一代AI工作站，以及即將進入量產階段的工作站繪圖卡新品，法人預估將為第四季營運增添新一波動能。
由於麗臺在中國市場的業務佔比超過六成，新一代工作站晶片符合規範並可順利銷往當地，剛好迎合中國市場對於高效能運算算力的迫切需求。
paras_en: Graphics‑card and AI solution provider LITEON (2465‑TW) this week, amid a sharp pullback in the Taiwan market, leveraged strong demand for NVIDIA workstation chips and a rally in its parent group’s AMD stock to attract net buying from foreign institutional investors. On the 30th, despite the market’s steep decline that pushed the stock to a limit‑down close at NT$102, foreign investors added 659 lots and have been net buyers for three consecutive sessions, accumulating 2,836 lots this week, a weekly gain of about 6% on a volume of 40,000 lots.

In terms of financial performance, LITEON’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of this year reached NT$7.39 billion, up 109.34% year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q3 hit NT$379 million, a 11.45‑fold increase from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$4.03, setting a new historical high.

On the business side, LITEON has benefited from the distribution of NVIDIA’s GB10 platform desktop supercomputers and high‑end workstation graphics accelerator cards, which have been in excess demand since the start of the year. Rising memory prices have also allowed product prices to be raised significantly, driving quarterly profit records. The rollout of a next‑generation AI workstation in the second half of the year and the upcoming mass production of a new workstation graphics card are expected by analysts to add a fresh boost to Q4 operations.

Because more than 60% of LITEON’s sales are in the Chinese market, the new generation workstation chips meet local regulations and can be sold there, perfectly aligning with China’s urgent demand for high‑performance computing power.

items.title: 馬斯克豪砸逾4.45億美元挺共和黨 傳記作者：期中選舉成個人政治十字軍東征
items.title_en: Musk Dumps Over $445 Million to Back Republicans, Biographer Says Midterms Are Personal Crusade
paras: 億萬富豪馬斯克(Elon Musk)已向共和黨相關政治團體投入超過4.45億美元，成為2026年美國期中選舉已知捐款金額最高的個人捐助者。馬斯克的傳記作者、知名歷史學家艾薩克森(Walter Isaacson)指出，馬斯克如今已將這場選舉視為一場個人政治「十字軍東征」，全力站在共和黨一方，而且驅動他的主要力量並非企業利益，而是對美國政治未來的深層憂慮。
艾薩克森周五(30日)接受《CNBC》節目《Squawk Box》訪問時表示，馬斯克現在「完全投入共和黨陣營」，並認為他已經把政治鬥爭視為個人使命。這番評論正值美國11月3日期中選舉前夕，馬斯克持續擴大對共和黨候選人及政治組織的資金支持。
馬斯克此前警告，如果民主黨在2028年同時拿下國會與總統大選，美國可能演變成「永久一黨制國家」，甚至形容這將是「美國的終局」。艾薩克森認為，馬斯克對民主黨可能重新取得全面執政權力的擔憂，已成為他投入政治活動的重要原因。
馬斯克的政治捐款規模也遠超過他先前的投入。2025年5月，馬斯克曾表示將減少政治支出，並稱自己「已經做得夠多了」。然而，根據美聯社(AP)資料，馬斯克目前已向2026年期中選舉的共和黨相關政治團體捐出逾4.45億美元，不僅成為目前已知最大個人捐助者，也超過他在2024年選舉週期投入的約2.9億美元。
不過，馬斯克這次的政治運作方式與過去高調介入政治有所不同。艾薩克森表示，馬斯克現在更傾向在幕後低調行動，將資源集中於選民動員及針對性廣告，而不是公開製造政治話題。
馬斯克過去也曾在艾薩克森的Podcast節目中承認，自己在政府任職期間應該更低調。談到當時手持電鋸出席活動的畫面，馬斯克坦言自己「有點太投入了」。艾薩克森認為，馬斯克如今似乎已從過去高調、戲劇化的政治表演，轉向更有策略的幕後資金與選舉操作。
德州參議員選戰是馬斯克目前關注的重點之一。艾薩克森指出，馬斯克希望擊敗民主黨候選人詹姆斯·塔拉里科(James Talarico)，後者正與共和黨候選人肯·帕克斯頓(Ken Paxton)競逐參議院席次。
在資金投入方面，馬斯克已向參議院領導基金(Senate Leadership Fund)捐出1.58億美元，該基金隨後將相應資金轉交給支持帕克斯頓的政治團體。不過，預測市場對這場選戰的判斷並未完全站在共和黨一方。Polymarket交易者周五給予塔拉里科71%的勝選機率，相關市場交易金額約856萬美元。
此外，Benzinga周四報導，民調機構Verasight的調查結果顯示，德州參議員選戰可能比預測市場反映的情況更加接近。至於全美國會選情，Polymarket交易者則給予民主黨94%的機率拿下眾議院控制權，以及72%的機率取得參議院多數席次。
艾薩克森也警告，馬斯克如此鮮明的政治立場，可能為旗下企業帶來監管與政治風險。馬斯克旗下太空探索技術公司SpaceX (SPCX-US)的業務涉及美國國家航空暨太空總署(NASA)及聯邦航空總署(FAA)的許可與監管；電動車製造商特斯拉 (Tesla) (TSLA-US)同樣受到聯邦政府監管。
艾薩克森指出，如果民主黨重新掌握國會與白宮，馬斯克旗下企業可能面臨各種調查，甚至遭遇政治報復。他認為，從一般企業政府事務部門的角度來看，馬斯克目前的政治介入方式並不是企業通常會建議採取的策略，因為這可能使企業與未來的政府監管機構陷入不必要的對立。
然而，艾薩克森懷疑馬斯克並沒有仔細衡量政治投入可能帶來的商業後果。他表示，馬斯克似乎不是在進行利益得失計算，而是受到內心深處的政治恐懼所驅動。艾薩克森說：「我不認為他是在計算利弊，我認為他只是受到某些政治恐懼深深驅使。」
隨著11月3日期中選舉逼近，馬斯克投入共和黨的資金規模與政治影響力，已成為選戰焦點之一。這場選舉不僅攸關國會控制權，也可能影響未來美國政府對大型科技企業、太空產業及電動車產業的監管方向。對馬斯克而言，支持共和黨或許是他對美國政治走向的直接押注，但若民主黨重新掌握國會與白宮，這項政治選擇也可能轉化為旗下企業必須承擔的政策風險。
paras_en: Billionaire Elon Musk has contributed more than $445 million to Republican‑aligned political groups, making him the largest known individual donor for the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. Musk’s biographer, noted historian Walter Isaacson, says Musk now treats the race as a personal political “crusade,” fully backing the GOP, and that his motivation stems not from corporate interests but from deep concerns about America’s political future.

Isaacson told CNBC’s “Squawk Box” on Friday (the 30th) that Musk is “all‑in with the Republican camp” and sees political fighting as a personal mission. The comments come on the eve of the November 3 midterms, as Musk continues to expand funding for Republican candidates and organizations.

Musk previously warned that if Democrats win both Congress and the presidency in 2028, the United States could become a “permanent one‑party state,” even calling it the “end of America.” Isaacson believes Musk’s fear of a Democratic return to full power is a key driver of his political activity.

Musk’s political giving now dwarfs his earlier contributions. In May 2025 he said he would cut back on political spending, claiming he had “done enough.” Yet, according to the Associated Press, Musk has now donated over $445 million to Republican‑aligned groups for the 2026 midterms, eclipsing his roughly $290 million outlay in the 2024 election cycle.

However, Musk’s current political strategy differs from his past high‑profile interventions. Isaacson says Musk now prefers to operate quietly behind the scenes, focusing resources on voter mobilization and targeted ads rather than publicly generating political headlines.

Musk previously admitted on Isaacson’s podcast that he should have been more low‑key while serving in government. Recalling a moment when he showed up at an event wielding a chainsaw, Musk said he was “a bit too into it.” Isaacson notes that Musk appears to have shifted from flamboyant, theatrical politics to a more strategic, behind‑the‑scenes funding and election operation.
The Texas Senate race is one of Musk’s current focal points. Isaacson notes that Musk wants to defeat Democratic candidate James Talarico, who is battling Republican Ken Paxton for the Senate seat.

In terms of money, Musk has given $158 million to the Senate Leadership Fund, which will funnel the cash to groups supporting Paxton. Yet market predictions have not fully sided with the GOP: Polymarket traders on Friday gave Talarico a 71 % chance of winning, with about $8.56 million wagered on the outcome.

Benzinga reported on Thursday that pollster Verasight’s survey suggests the Texas Senate contest may be tighter than the market odds indicate. Nationwide, Polymarket traders assign Democrats a 94 % chance of controlling the House and a 72 % chance of holding a Senate majority.

Isaacson also warns that Musk’s stark political stance could expose his companies to regulatory and political risk. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) depends on NASA and FAA permits, while Tesla (TSLA‑US) is likewise subject to federal oversight.

He points out that if Democrats regain Congress and the White House, Musk’s firms could face investigations or even political retaliation. From a typical corporate government‑affairs perspective, Isaacson says Musk’s current level of political involvement is not the strategy most companies would recommend, as it could pit the business against future regulators.

Nevertheless, Isaacson doubts Musk has weighed the commercial fallout of his political spending. He argues Musk is not doing a cost‑benefit analysis but is driven by a deep‑seated political fear. “I don’t think he’s calculating the pros and cons,” Isaacson said. “I think he’s simply being propelled by some profound political anxieties.”

As the November 3 midterms approach, Musk’s massive funding of the GOP and his political influence have become a focal point of the race. The election will decide congressional control and could shape future U.S. regulation of big‑tech, the space sector and the electric‑vehicle industry. For Musk, backing Republicans may be a direct bet on America’s political direction, but a Democratic resurgence could turn that choice into policy risk for his companies.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉科妍玻尿酸產品有望攻千億人民幣醫美市場 喜迎兩根漲停周漲近2成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Koyan’s Hyaluronic Acid Product Poised to Tap Trillion‑RMB Medical‑Aesthetic Market, Enjoys Two Limit‑Up Days, Weekly Rise Near 20%
paras: 科妍(1786-TW)旗下最新第三代雙重交聯技術產品「法思麗輕感皮下填補劑(含利多卡因注射用交聯透明質酸鈉凝膠)」，已正式通過中國國家藥品監督管理局(NMPA)審查，取得三類醫療器材器械註冊證書，有望搶攻千億人民幣的醫美市場，激勵科妍本周喜迎2根漲停，周漲近2成。
科妍本周大漲19.77%，並於周四(29日)、周五(30日)連2日亮紅燈，周五收47.55元，一舉站回5日線、月線以及季線。三大法人連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超304張。
科妍指出，「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」含有利多卡因，用於面部鼻唇溝部位真皮組織中層至深層注射，以矯正中度或重度的鼻唇溝，並可有減舒緩注射過程中的疼痛感。
而此次取證的「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」於2023年送件，並通過審查與補件程序，突破中國合規醫美市場的高難度准入門檻，也是台灣首張於中國獲准上市的「含藥(利多卡因)透明質酸皮下植入劑」證書。
根據產業研究機構報告，2026年中國注射醫美市場針劑數量已超過千萬支，且經濟規模已達2000億人民幣以上，其中，玻尿酸皮下填補劑為主要成長動能。科妍預期，隨著「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」取得中國認證，將進一步挹注營運。
paras_en: Koyan (1786‑TW) announced that its latest third‑generation dual‑crosslinked product, Fasili Light‑Feel Subdermal Filler (containing lidocaine‑based crosslinked sodium hyaluronate gel), has passed review by China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) and obtained a Class‑III medical device registration certificate, positioning it to capture a market worth a trillion RMB in medical aesthetics and prompting the stock to hit two limit‑up days this week, lifting its weekly gain to nearly 20%.

The stock surged 19.77% this week and lit up red on both Thursday (the 29th) and Friday (the 30th), closing at NT$47.55 on Friday and reclaiming its 5‑day, monthly and quarterly moving averages. The three major institutional investors bought net shares for three consecutive trading days, totaling a net purchase of 304 lots for the week.

Koyan explained that Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) contains lidocaine and is intended for mid‑to‑deep dermal injections in the nasolabial fold area to correct moderate to severe folds, while also helping to alleviate pain during the injection procedure.

The certified Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) was submitted for approval in 2023, passed the review and supplemental documentation stages, overcoming the high‑threshold compliance barrier of China’s medical‑aesthetic market. It is also Taiwan’s first “drug‑containing (lidocaine) hyaluronic acid subdermal implant” to receive approval for sale in China.

According to an industry research report, China’s injectable medical‑aesthetic market will exceed ten million syringes by 2026, with an economic scale surpassing RMB 2000 billion, driven primarily by hyaluronic acid fillers. Koyan expects that the Chinese certification of Fasili Light‑Feel (with lidocaine) will further boost its operations.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉東捷資訊搭資安題材 逆勢續漲近2成創近1年新高價
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Dongjie Information Leverages Cybersecurity Theme to Rise Nearly 20% Against the Trend, Hits One‑Year High
paras: 資訊軟體服務商東捷資訊 (6697-TW) 本周股價再度大漲，並未受大盤重挫的衝擊，走出自己的路，周漲幅高達18%，合計二周來漲幅近30%，最高來到去年11月中旬以來高點，反映資安題材。
由於全球資安問題擴大，近期全球約70%網站運作的開源程式語言 PHP 被揭露存在兩項高危險性安全漏洞，資安議題再度受市場關注。
東捷資訊表示，攜手國際頂尖資安原廠建立夥伴關係，提供從事前資安盤點、檢測，到事中監控與事後支援的全方位服務，可協助企業將傳統被動防禦，升級為主動阻斷威脅的零信任顧問服務。
目前東捷資訊ERP建置案穩步推進，數據治理等智慧應用也陸續導入客戶場域並開始上線，同時優化產品組合。
東捷資訊上半年已完成鋼鐵製造大廠、電動車零組件製造大廠和 AI 技術軟體公司等多項 SAP 雲端 ERP 建置專案，並為國內知名醫療院所導入供應商交期管理系統，成功將業務拓展至醫療產業。
paras_en: Information software service provider Dongjie Information (6697‑TW) saw its stock surge again this week, shrugging off the market’s broad decline and carving its own path. The weekly gain hit 18%, bringing the two‑week rise to nearly 30% and pushing the price to its highest level since mid‑November last year, reflecting the cybersecurity theme.

As global cybersecurity concerns grow, two high‑severity vulnerabilities have been disclosed in PHP—the open‑source programming language that powers roughly 70% of websites worldwide, drawing renewed market attention to security issues.

Dongjie Information said it has partnered with leading international cybersecurity vendors to offer end‑to‑end services—from pre‑emptive security assessments and testing to real‑time monitoring and post‑incident support—helping enterprises upgrade from traditional passive defenses to proactive, zero‑trust threat‑blocking consulting services.

Its ERP implementation projects are progressing steadily, and smart applications such as data governance are being gradually rolled out at customer sites and going live, while the company continues to optimize its product portfolio.

In the first half of the year, Dongjie Information completed several SAP cloud ERP projects for major steel manufacturers, electric‑vehicle component makers and AI software firms, and also deployed a supplier delivery‑date management system for a well‑known domestic medical institution, successfully expanding its business into the healthcare sector.

items.title: 國內銀行「第一」槍！一銀粉獅幣點數可兌換USDT 攜手HOYA BIT跨幣圈
items.title_en: Domestic Bank Leads the Way! First Bank’s “Pink Lion Coin” Points Can Be Exchanged for USDT in Partnership with HOYA BIT
paras: 第一銀行積極拓展數位生態圈，攜手台灣加密貨幣交易所HOYA BIT，於粉獅幣平台推出泰達幣（USDT）兌換服務，創下國內銀行全通路點數結合穩定幣應用的首例。客戶除可兌換一般生活商品外，更能將點數轉換為數位資產，開創點數經濟新連結。一銀長期深耕區塊鏈技術，曾取得跨鏈專利並應用於供應鏈融資與外幣現鈔交易，持續秉持穩健創新理念掌握數位金融契機。
面對全球數位資產及穩定幣應用技術快速發展，第一銀行持續深化金融科技創新布局，宣布攜手台灣加密貨幣交易所HOYA BIT（禾亞數位科技），正式於粉獅幣平台推出泰達幣（USDT）兌換服務。此舉創下國內銀行首開全通路點數結合穩定幣應用的創新嘗試，不僅進一步拓展數位點數應用場景，更打造串聯傳統金融與數位資產生態的新體驗。
「粉獅幣」為第一銀行打造的點數生態平台，原本即提供客戶兌換咖啡、餐飲、生活用品、票券及數位商品等多元回饋項目。本次服務升級後，客戶可直接使用粉獅幣兌換泰達幣，讓銀行點數順利突破傳統回饋框架，創造點數經濟與數位資產應用的全新連結，為廣大客戶提供更多元且具未來性的數位金融體驗。
第一銀行長期深耕區塊鏈技術與創新金融應用，從前瞻研發到場景落地，逐步累積豐富的數位金融發展基礎。一銀過去曾取得全球首創跨鏈整合區塊鏈發明專利，並攜手企業夥伴推動區塊鏈供應鏈融資應用，透過分散式帳本技術有效提升融資流程效率與資訊透明度。同時，一銀更率先建置銀行同業外幣現鈔買賣區塊鏈平台，大幅優化銀行間外幣現鈔交易與資訊交換機制。
積極布局數位資產領域的第一銀行表示，未來將持續追蹤國際監理制度及市場趨勢，積極探索數位資產與金融服務結合的各類創新應用。一銀將透過跨產業合作持續拓展服務場景，秉持「穩健創新、安全發展」的核心理念，打造更便利、更安全且更具前瞻性的服務體驗，精準掌握數位資產及區塊鏈技術發展的重大契機。
paras_en: First Bank is actively expanding its digital ecosystem by partnering with Taiwan cryptocurrency exchange HOYA BIT to launch a USDT (Tether) redemption service on its Pink Lion Coin platform, marking the first instance in the country of a bank integrating points across all channels with a stablecoin. Customers can not only redeem points for everyday goods but also convert them into digital assets, creating a new link in the points economy. First Bank has long cultivated blockchain technology, securing a cross‑chain patent applied to supply‑chain financing and foreign‑cash transactions, and continues to pursue stable, innovative approaches to seize digital finance opportunities.

Facing the rapid global development of digital assets and stable‑coin applications, First Bank is deepening its fintech innovation strategy and announced a partnership with Taiwan crypto exchange HOYA BIT (He Ya Digital Technology) to officially roll out a USDT redemption service on the Pink Lion Coin platform. This move creates the first domestic‑bank innovation that combines points across all channels with a stablecoin, further expanding digital‑point use cases and forging a new experience that links traditional finance with the digital‑asset ecosystem.

“Pink Lion Coin” is the points‑ecosystem platform built by First Bank, originally offering customers redemption options such as coffee, dining, everyday goods, tickets and digital products. After the service upgrade, customers can directly use Pink Lion Coins to exchange for USDT, allowing bank points to break out of the traditional reward framework and creating a brand‑new connection between the points economy and digital‑asset usage, providing a more diverse and forward‑looking digital‑finance experience for a wide customer base.

First Bank has long been devoted to blockchain technology and innovative financial applications, building a solid foundation for digital finance from forward‑looking R&D to real‑world deployment. The bank previously secured the world’s first cross‑chain blockchain integration patent and collaborated with corporate partners to promote blockchain‑based supply‑chain financing, using distributed ledger technology to improve financing efficiency and information transparency. In addition, First Bank was the first to establish a blockchain platform for inter‑bank foreign‑cash buying and selling, greatly optimizing the exchange and information‑sharing mechanisms for foreign cash among banks.

With an active strategy in the digital‑asset space, First Bank says it will continue to monitor international regulatory regimes and market trends, actively exploring various innovative applications that combine digital assets with financial services. The bank will keep expanding service scenarios through cross‑industry collaborations, adhering to its core principle of “steady innovation, safe development” to deliver more convenient, secure and forward‑looking experiences, and precisely capture the major opportunities presented by digital‑asset and blockchain technology development.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉麗臺輝達工作站新品與獲利爆發加持 無懼大盤回檔獲外資逆勢買超
items.title_en: Hot Stock: LITEON’s New NVIDIA Workstation Products and Profit Surge Boost, Unfazed by Market Pullback, Foreign Investors Buy Against the Trend
paras: 顯卡暨人工智慧解決方案供應商麗臺(2465-TW)本週在台股大盤面臨崩跌回檔壓力之際，憑藉輝達工作站晶片拉貨暢旺與母集團美超微股價走揚帶動，獲得外資法人逆勢買超力挺。30日雖受大盤大跌拖累回檔亮燈跌停收在102元，外資當日依舊加碼買超659張，並且連續三個交易日站在買方，累計買超達2836張，周漲幅約6%，周成交量4萬張。

業務動能部分，麗臺受惠經銷代理輝達GB10平台的桌上型超級電腦，以及高階工作站繪圖晶片加速卡今年以來供不應求，加上記憶體價格上漲帶動產品售價顯著調升，成為推升獲利逐季創高的重要引擎。下半年接續推出新一代AI工作站，以及即將進入量產階段的工作站繪圖卡新品，法人預估將為第四季營運增添新一波動能。
由於麗臺在中國市場的業務佔比超過六成，新一代工作站晶片符合規範並可順利銷往當地，剛好迎合中國市場對於高效能運算算力的迫切需求。
paras_en: Graphics‑card and AI solution provider LITEON (2465‑TW) this week, amid a sharp pullback in the Taiwan market, leveraged strong demand for NVIDIA workstation chips and a rally in its parent group’s AMD stock to attract net buying from foreign institutional investors. On the 30th, despite the market’s steep decline that pushed the stock to a limit‑down close at NT$102, foreign investors added 659 lots and have been net buyers for three consecutive sessions, accumulating 2,836 lots this week, a weekly gain of about 6% on a volume of 40,000 lots.

In terms of financial performance, LITEON’s cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of this year reached NT$7.39 billion, up 109.34% year‑over‑year. Net profit after tax for Q3 hit NT$379 million, a 11.45‑fold increase from the same period last year, with earnings per share of NT$4.03, setting a new historical high.

On the business side, LITEON has benefited from the distribution of NVIDIA’s GB10 platform desktop supercomputers and high‑end workstation graphics accelerator cards, which have been in excess demand since the start of the year. Rising memory prices have also allowed product prices to be raised significantly, driving quarterly profit records. The rollout of a next‑generation AI workstation in the second half of the year and the upcoming mass production of a new workstation graphics card are expected by analysts to add a fresh boost to Q4 operations.

Because more than 60% of LITEON’s sales are in the Chinese market, the new generation workstation chips meet local regulations and can be sold there, perfectly aligning with China’s urgent demand for high‑performance computing power.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉科妍玻尿酸產品有望攻千億人民幣醫美市場 喜迎兩根漲停周漲近2成

paras: 科妍(1786-TW)旗下最新第三代雙重交聯技術產品「法思麗輕感皮下填補劑(含利多卡因注射用交聯透明質酸鈉凝膠)」，已正式通過中國國家藥品監督管理局(NMPA)審查，取得三類醫療器材器械註冊證書，有望搶攻千億人民幣的醫美市場，激勵科妍本周喜迎2根漲停，周漲近2成。
科妍本周大漲19.77%，並於周四(29日)、周五(30日)連2日亮紅燈，周五收47.55元，一舉站回5日線、月線以及季線。三大法人連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超304張。
科妍指出，「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」含有利多卡因，用於面部鼻唇溝部位真皮組織中層至深層注射，以矯正中度或重度的鼻唇溝，並可有減舒緩注射過程中的疼痛感。
而此次取證的「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」於2023年送件，並通過審查與補件程序，突破中國合規醫美市場的高難度准入門檻，也是台灣首張於中國獲准上市的「含藥(利多卡因)透明質酸皮下植入劑」證書。
根據產業研究機構報告，2026年中國注射醫美市場針劑數量已超過千萬支，且經濟規模已達2000億人民幣以上，其中，玻尿酸皮下填補劑為主要成長動能。科妍預期，隨著「法思麗輕感(含利多卡因)」取得中國認證，將進一步挹注營運。

items.title: 鴻海科技日登場、電子權值股法說周、景氣燈號連10紅 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: Foxconn Tech Day, Electronic Stocks Earnings Calls, 10-Month Red Economic Signal – Weekly Highlights
paras: 鴻海科技日周五(30日)登場，董事長劉揚偉指出，鴻海AI伺服器機架周產能已較去年翻倍，達2000架，並看好明年營運維持雙位數成長；台達電、聯電及日月光等電子權值股本周紛紛召開法說會，並釋出最新展望；國發會周四(29日)發布景氣燈號，連續10個月亮紅燈，也是疫情以來最長的紅燈周期紀錄，以下為本周大事回顧：

〈鴻海科技日〉劉揚偉：今年展現集團加乘力與垂直整合力 AI伺服器機架產能已較去年翻倍 

鴻海(2317-TW)周五(30日)舉行2026年鴻海科技日，董事長劉揚偉於開幕致詞時表示，今年邁入第七屆，也是歷年規模最大的一次，特別要向外界展示鴻海的「加乘力」及「垂直整合力」。他也透露，短短一年內，鴻海AI伺服器機架週產能已從上次科技日的1,000架翻倍至每週2,000架，展現快速擴大AI伺服器製造規模的能力。
另外，劉揚偉會後受訪時也表示，明年產業景氣仍呈現K型發展，AI資料中心相關需求持續向上，其他產業則呈現不同走勢，預期鴻海明年營運仍可維持雙位數成長。

〈台達電法說〉Q4營收估季增、毛利率不低於上季 馬國將設大型生產據點 

台達電(2308-TW)周四(29日)召開法說會，董事長鄭平表示，第四季營收一定高於第三季，毛利率則不會比第三季差，但年底仍有部分無形資產等項目需要檢視。展望明年，隨著AI資料中心建置需求持續，預期整體營運仍將維持成長趨勢，AI及資料中心相關業務將持續扮演主要成長動能。全球產能布局方面，台達電董事會已通過在馬來西亞檳城設立大型生產據點。

〈日月光法說〉Q4 營收估季增 6-8%、再度追加資本支出 LEAP目標上修明年可望翻倍 

半導體封測廠日月光投控 (3711-TW) 周四(29日)召開法說，展望第四季，日月光投控預估，在 1 美元兌 31.9 元新台幣的匯率假設下，集團合併營收將季增 6% 至 8%；另因應先進封裝需求持續強勁，宣布2026年資本支出追加 10 億美元，由原先 105 億美元上調至 115 億美元，再創歷史新高。

〈聯電法說〉追加32億美元資本支出 三年內AI營收占比衝25% 

晶圓代工廠聯電(2303-TW)周三(28日)召開線上法說會，並宣布董事會已核准追加約32億美元資本支出，加速新加坡與台南廠區擴充工程，聯電定調在矽光子與先進封裝帶動下，未來三年內AI相關營收將從目前約3億美元大幅拉升，占全公司營收比重衝上25%。

〈景氣燈號〉疫後最長擴張連10紅！分數升至41分 國發會看好3大引擎支撐燈號續紅 

國發會周四(29日)發布2026年9月景氣概況，景氣對策信號綜合判斷分數達41分，較8月下修值40分增加1分，燈號連續10個月亮出紅燈，創下疫情以來最長的紅燈周期紀錄。這波擴張主要受惠於人工智慧相關產業生產動能強勁，帶動工業及服務業加班工時轉呈黃紅燈。同時，領先與同時指標皆續呈上升，確認台灣經濟正處穩健成長軌道。經濟發展處處長陳美菊提出三大重點，看好出口、投資與消費將持續扮演拉抬經濟的關鍵引擎。

TSIA估台灣半導體今年產值達5.3兆元大增22% 力挺政府重啟核電評估 

TSIA台灣半導體協會周四(29日)舉辦30周年年會，現任理事長侯永清表示，預估2026年台灣半導體產業總產值突破5.3兆元，年增率達22%，同時正式表態在合規與安全前提下支持政府重啟核電評估，並將攜手權值龍頭台積電(2330-TW)等夥伴壯大生態系。

〈楊金龍立院備詢〉重申匯市依循「柳樹理論」可防範波動過大

paras_en: Foxconn (2317‑TW) held its 2026 Tech Day on Friday, October 30, with Chairman Liu Yang‑wei announcing that the weekly production capacity of its AI server racks has doubled from 1,000 units at the last Tech Day to 2,000 units, and that the company expects double‑digit growth in operations next year.

The company expects continued growth driven by AI data center construction, with AI and data center businesses remaining key growth drivers. The board approved a large production site in Penang, Malaysia.

The Economic Development Council’s 10‑month red‑light record reflects the strongest AI‑driven expansion since the pandemic, with exports, investment, and consumption poised to keep the economy on a robust growth path.
