items.title: 亞馬遜未來支出承諾飆至8836億美元 新增800億美元融資額度支援AI擴張
items.title_en: Amazon’s Future Spending Commitment Soars to $883.581 Billion, Adds $80 Billion Financing Facility to Support AI Expansion
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資持續擴大的同時，正面臨日益沉重的資金壓力。根據公司最新提交給美國證券交易委員會(SEC)的第三季文件，截至2026年9月底，亞馬遜未來合約支出承諾總額已攀升至8,835.81億美元，較前一季增加36%，更是2025年同期的兩倍以上。為支應資料中心及AI硬體採購，公司也新增最高800億美元的供應商融資貸款額度，進一步擴大籌資管道。
這項融資安排允許亞馬遜自行決定是否動用資金，期間自2027年第一季起至2028年第三季止，貸款期限則從每筆實際借款日起算，最長為5年，利率採浮動利率。作為擔保，亞馬遜將針對部分透過融資安排購買的資產提供擔保權益，相關未償還金額將列入公司資產負債表的長期債務。
不過，800億美元只是可使用的融資上限，並非亞馬遜已經借入的金額，公司也沒有承諾一定會動用全部額度。文件並未揭露具體哪些採購資產將作為擔保，也未公布參與貸款的金融機構及實際融資利率。
亞馬遜雲端運算部門Amazon Web Services (AWS)執行長馬特·加曼(Matt Garman)周五(30日)接受《彭博電視》訪問時表示，當公司看到眼前存在如此龐大的機會，就會尋找負責任的融資方式，以便盡可能擴大對客戶的服務規模。他也指出，隨著公司積極加速投資，亞馬遜正與合作夥伴研究如何平衡相關現金流。
過去，亞馬遜主要依靠雲端運算、零售等業務產生的營運現金流，以及大規模發行公司債，支應資料中心建設與晶片採購。此次新增供應商融資安排，則讓公司可以針對技術基礎設施採購取得額外資金，降低所有投資支出都由自身現金流承擔的壓力。

亞馬遜截至9月底的8,835.81億美元合約支出承諾，涵蓋範圍相當廣泛，並不等同於目前已經背負的有息債務，也不代表所有款項都必須在短期內支付。根據公司文件，這些承諾包括長期債務本金與利息2,942.54億美元、尚未開始的租約1,649.22億美元、不動產及設備採購承諾1,596.40億美元、營運租賃負債1,214.92億美元、無條件採購義務947.59億美元、融資租賃負債179.55億美元、融資義務115.65億美元，以及其他承諾189.94億美元。
其中，尚未開始的租約及不動產、設備採購承諾，反映亞馬遜為未來資料中心與技術基礎設施擴張所預留的資源。這些支出將隨著相關設施啟用及採購交付逐步轉化為實際付款義務，也使公司未來數年的資金需求更加龐大。
第三季財報進一步顯示，亞馬遜的AI投資已明顯推高資本支出。公司第三季現金資本支出達759億美元，遠高於2025年同期的342億美元；今年前9個月累計達1,722億美元，也大幅超過去年同期的899億美元。亞馬遜維持2026年全年現金資本支出約2,200億美元的預估，並預期2027年支出將進一步顯著增加，主要由技術基礎設施投資帶動。
資本支出快速增加，也使自由現金流由正轉負。亞馬遜截至2026年9月的過去12個月，自由現金流為負423.57億美元，與2025年同期正147.88億美元相比，減少約571億美元。同期營運現金流則由1,306.91億美元增加至1,683億美元，顯示核心業務仍持續創造現金，但設備與基礎設施投資的增幅更大，抵銷了營運現金流成長。
從資產負債表來看，亞馬遜截至9月底持有現金、約當現金及有價證券合計1,142億美元，低於2025年底的1,230億美元；長期債務則由去年底的656.48億美元升至1,731.25億美元，增加逾一倍。公司第三季營運現金流為424.22億美元，高於去年同期的355.25億美元，但大量資金仍持續投入資本支出及其他投資。
儘管現金流承受壓力，亞馬遜的雲端業務仍展現強勁成長。第三季AWS營收達459.84億美元，年增39%，高於去年同期的330.06億美元；營業利益則由114.34億美元升至177.73億美元。AWS營收成長速度加快，是亞馬遜持續擴大AI資料中心與技術基礎設施投資的重要支撐。
亞馬遜第三季合併營收為2,019.44億美元，年增12%；營業利益280.76億美元，高於去年同期的174.22億美元；淨利則為206.85億美元，略低於去年同期的211.87億美元。從業務結構來看，AWS營收占公司總營收比重已由去年同期的18%升至23%，雲端業務的重要性持續提高。
亞馬遜此次新增800億美元融資額度，反映AI基礎設施競賽已不只是技術與市場需求之爭，也逐漸成為資金調度及資產負債表管理的考驗。公司雖然仍擁有強勁的營運現金流，AWS成長也提供持續投資的商業基礎，但自由現金流轉負、長期債務攀升及未來合約支出承諾快速擴大，都意味著AI擴張需要更複雜的融資安排。
對投資人而言，關鍵不僅是亞馬遜能否持續擴建資料中心、取得晶片與運算資源，更在於這些投資能否轉化為足夠的AWS營收、營業利益及長期自由現金流。若AI需求持續強勁，龐大資本支出可能成為鞏固雲端市場地位的基礎；但若投資回收速度不如預期，快速增加的債務與長期支出承諾，也可能成為未來財務彈性的負擔。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is expanding its AI infrastructure investments while facing mounting financing pressure. According to the company’s latest third‑quarter filing with the U.S. SEC, as of the end of September 2026 the total amount of future contract spending commitments rose to $883.581 billion, up 36% from the prior quarter and more than double the level at the same time in 2025. To fund data‑center and AI‑hardware purchases, the company also added a new supplier‑financing loan facility of up to $80 billion, further widening its funding sources.

The financing arrangement allows Amazon to decide whether to draw down funds, covering the period from Q1 2027 through Q3 2028, with each loan’s term measured from the actual borrowing date and capped at a maximum of five years at a floating interest rate. As collateral, Amazon will grant security interests in certain assets purchased through the facility, and the outstanding amounts will be recorded as long‑term debt on the balance sheet.

However, the $80 billion is merely the ceiling of usable financing, not an amount already borrowed, and the company has not committed to using the full limit. The filing does not disclose which purchased assets will serve as collateral, nor does it name the lending institutions or the actual financing rates.

Matt Garman, chief executive of Amazon Web Services (AWS), told Bloomberg Television on Friday the 30th that when the company sees such a massive opportunity it looks for responsible financing methods to expand service capacity for customers as much as possible. He added that as Amazon accelerates its investments, it is working with partners to balance the related cash flows.

Historically, Amazon has relied on operating cash flow from its cloud and retail businesses and large corporate bond issuances to fund data‑center construction and chip purchases. The new supplier‑financing arrangement gives the company additional capital for technology‑infrastructure procurement, reducing the pressure of funding all investments solely from its own cash flow.

Amazon’s $883.581 billion contract‑spending commitment as of September‑end covers a broad range of items and is not equivalent to existing interest‑bearing debt, nor does it mean all amounts must be paid in the short term. The commitments include $294.254 billion of long‑term debt principal and interest, $164.922 billion of leases not yet commenced, $159.640 billion of real‑estate and equipment purchase commitments, $121.492 billion of operating lease liabilities, $94.759 billion of unconditional purchase obligations, $17.955 billion of finance‑lease liabilities, $11.565 billion of financing obligations, and $18.994 billion of other commitments.

The not‑yet‑commenced leases and real‑estate/equipment purchase commitments reflect resources set aside for future data‑center and technology‑infrastructure expansion. These expenditures will gradually turn into actual payment obligations as facilities are activated and deliveries made, further enlarging Amazon’s funding needs for the coming years.

The third‑quarter results show that Amazon’s AI investments have markedly lifted capital expenditures. Capital spending in Q3 reached $75.9 billion, far above $34.2 billion in the same quarter of 2025; for the first nine months of the year it totaled $172.2 billion, also well above $89.9 billion a year earlier. Amazon maintains its 2026 full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook of roughly $220 billion and expects 2027 spending to rise further, driven mainly by technology‑infrastructure investment.

The rapid rise in capex has turned free cash flow negative. Over the twelve months ending September 2026, Amazon’s free cash flow was a negative $42.357 billion, down about $57.1 billion from the positive $14.788 billion in the comparable 2025 period. Operating cash flow in the same span grew from $130.691 billion to $168.3 billion, showing the core business still generates cash, but the surge in equipment and infrastructure spending more than offsets that growth.

From the balance sheet, Amazon held $114.2 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at September‑end, down from $123.0 billion at the end of 2025. Long‑term debt rose from $65.648 billion at the end of last year to $173.125 billion, more than doubling. Third‑quarter operating cash flow was $42.422 billion, up from $35.525 billion a year earlier, yet large sums continue to be deployed to capex and other investments.

Despite cash‑flow pressure, Amazon’s cloud business remains strong. AWS revenue in Q3 was $45.984 billion, up 39% year‑over‑year, versus $33.006 billion a year ago; operating income rose from $11.434 billion to $17.773 billion. The accelerating AWS revenue growth underpins Amazon’s ongoing expansion of AI data centers and technology‑infrastructure spending.

Amazon’s consolidated Q3 revenue was $201.944 billion, up 12% year‑over‑year; operating income was $28.076 billion, higher than $17.422 billion a year earlier; net income was $20.685 billion, slightly below $21.187 billion in the prior year. AWS now accounts for 23% of total revenue, up from 18% a year ago, reflecting the growing importance of the cloud segment.

The new $80 billion financing facility highlights that the AI‑infrastructure race is no longer just about technology and market demand but also about capital allocation and balance‑sheet management. While Amazon still enjoys strong operating cash flow and AWS growth provides a solid investment base, the shift to negative free cash flow, rising long‑term debt and rapidly expanding contract‑spending commitments indicate that AI expansion will require increasingly complex financing structures.

For investors, the key question is not only whether Amazon can keep building data centers, securing chips and compute capacity, but also whether those investments translate into sufficient AWS revenue, operating profit and long‑term free cash flow. If AI demand stays robust, the massive capex could cement its cloud market position; however, if investment pay‑back lags, the swiftly growing debt and long‑term spending commitments could strain future financial flexibility.

items.title: OpenAI大砍募資目標100億美元！估值降至1.25兆美元、投資人縮減認購
items.title_en: OpenAI Slashes Funding Goal by $10 Billion, Valuation Cut to $1.25 Trillion as Investors Trim Commitments
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮面臨市場重新評價之際，OpenAI傳出下修最新一輪募資目標，募資規模較原定計畫減少100億美元，目標估值也從1.4兆美元降至1.25兆美元。
根據《金融時報》週五（30日）引述知情人士報導，ChatGPT開發商OpenAI目前尋求募資約200億美元，並已設定週五為投資人承諾參與本輪募資的截止日。
不過，由於部分投資人縮減認購額度，預計首輪交割實際募得金額將低於200億美元。
《金融時報》補充，包含阿拉伯聯合大公國政府支持的科技基金MGX在內的一個阿聯投資人財團，預計將成為本輪募資的最大參與者。作為交易的一部分，OpenAI將取得選擇權，可租用該地區新開發的運算資源。
此外，創投機構Founders Fund、Coatue、紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）及Andreessen Horowitz預計也將參與投資。
《金融時報》另指出，富裕個人投資者將有機會在後續的散戶發行計畫中，以1.25兆美元的估值投資OpenAI。
隨著市場對AI龐大支出的疑慮升高，美國科技股近期遭遇重挫。科技股比重較高的那斯達克指數週五下跌約2.9%，較10月6日創下的歷史收盤高點下跌7.8%。
《路透》先前報導，正計畫於2027年上市的OpenAI，積極尋求盡快完成本輪募資，部分原因是希望搶在Anthropic即將上市前完成交易，因為兩家公司鎖定的投資人群體相近。
paras_en: Amid a market re‑assessment of the AI investment boom, OpenAI has reportedly lowered its latest fundraising target, reducing the size of the round by $10 billion and cutting the target valuation from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

According to the Financial Times on Friday (the 30th), which cited sources familiar with the matter, ChatGPT developer OpenAI is now seeking roughly $20 billion in funding and has set Friday as the deadline for investors to commit to the round.
However, because some investors are scaling back their subscriptions, the amount actually raised in the first closing is expected to fall short of the $20 billion target.

The FT added that a consortium of UAE investors, including the government‑backed technology fund MGX, is expected to be the largest participant in the round. As part of the deal, OpenAI will obtain an option to lease newly built compute capacity in the region.
In addition, venture‑capital firms Founders Fund, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also slated to invest.
The FT also noted that wealthy individual investors will have the chance to invest in OpenAI in a later retail‑issuance program at the $1.25 trillion valuation.

As concerns grow over the massive spending required for AI, U.S. tech stocks have recently taken a sharp hit. The Nasdaq, which is heavily weighted toward tech, fell about 2.9% on Friday, a 7.8% drop from the all‑time closing high set on October 6.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI, which plans to go public in 2027, is pushing to close this round quickly, partly to complete the transaction before Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, since the two companies target largely overlapping investor bases.

items.title: 標普砍Meta信評展望至「負向」！AI支出失與現金流惡化引發擔憂
items.title_en: S&P Cuts Meta's Credit Outlook to "Negative" Over AI Spending and Deteriorating Cash Flow
paras: 標普全球評級(S&P Global Ratings)周五(30日)將Meta Platforms(META-US)的信用評等展望從「穩定」調降至「負向」，理由是這家社群媒體巨頭的資本支出與自由營運現金流前景存在重大不確定性。
標普表示，Meta的槓桿比率最早可能在2027年升至一倍以上。槓桿比率是債務相對於獲利的指標，而標普全球評級對「AA-」發行人信用評等設定的槓桿比率門檻為一倍。
標普指出，相較於同業，Meta將人工智慧(AI)投資轉化為營收的能力較為有限。未來幾年，AI營收來源何時才能產生足以超越成本攀升的重大貢獻，目前仍不明朗。
展望遭降代表Meta目前「AA-」的信評有在兩年內遭調降的風險，但也意味著標普全球目前並未積極考慮砍信評。「AA-」是第四高投資等級，即使被降一
大型科技公司過去長期投入大量資金發展雲端運算、網路廣告及電子商務，但AI熱潮已將資本支出推升至驚人水準，引發投資人擔憂，業者能否及時從相關投資中獲得足夠回報。
Meta上周預估全年資本支出將達1,350億至1,450億美元，在此同時，第3季現金缺口達21.2億美元。Meta也計劃進入公開市場籌資，發行價值975億美元的股票，以支應AI建設。

標普估Meta未來兩年現金流缺口擴大

標普目前預估，Meta自由營運現金流(FOCF)赤字將在2026年達390億美元，2027年進一步擴大至710億美元。
標普表示，龐大支出可能使Meta的自由營運現金流在2028年之後仍持續為負，並預期Meta將完全依靠舉債，填補2028年的現金缺口。
標普指出：「考量Meta未來資本支出的前景仍不明朗，加上AI投資計畫為期多年且極為積極，我們對Meta能否像先前預期那樣控制支出的信心已降低。」
Meta發言人說：「我們尊重但不同意標普對Meta AI變現能力的看法。」並指出，公司認為未來仍有「重大產品與業務機會」，足以支撐非常強健的信用狀況。

Meta槓桿比率攀升 標普警告信用狀況恐持續轉弱

標普表示，Meta的槓桿比率已從2025年的0.1倍上升，主因是Met選擇租用資料中心容量，而非透過發行債務融資。
標普全球評級美國媒體與電信產業主管Naveen Sarma說：「如果資本支出持續維持高檔，且成長速度超過我們的預期，企業信用狀況將持續惡化，現金流也將維持負值。」
截至9月30日，Meta的長期債務為809.2億美元。
標普周四也將博通(AVGO-US)的信評展望從「正向」調降至「穩定」，表示雖然AI業務快速成長，但營運上也更加依賴少數大型客戶。
標普今年稍早則將雲端運算巨頭甲骨文(ORCL-US)的信用評等下調至「BBB-」，只比非投資等級債券的門檻高一級，原因是該公司資產負債表的槓桿程度過高。
paras_en: S&P Global Ratings on Friday the 30th lowered Meta Platforms' (META-US) credit outlook from "Stable" to "Negative," citing significant uncertainty around the social‑media giant's capital spending and free operating cash‑flow outlook.
S&P said Meta's leverage ratio could rise above 1.0 as early as 2027. The leverage ratio measures debt relative to earnings, and S&P sets a 1.0 threshold for issuers rated "AA-".

S&P noted that, compared with peers, Meta's ability to turn AI investments into revenue is relatively limited, and it remains unclear when AI‑derived revenue will be large enough to offset rising costs in the coming years.

The outlook downgrade signals that Meta's "AA-" rating faces a risk of being cut within two years, but it also means S&P is not currently actively considering an outright rating downgrade. "AA-" is the fourth‑highest investment grade, even if it were to be lowered one notch.

Large tech firms have historically poured massive capital into cloud computing, online advertising and e‑commerce, but the AI boom has pushed capital expenditures to astonishing levels, raising investor concerns about whether companies can reap sufficient returns in time.

Meta last week projected full‑year capital spending of $135‑$145 billion, while its Q3 cash shortfall reached $2.12 billion. The company also plans to raise funds in the public market, issuing $97.5 billion of stock to finance AI development.
S&P now estimates Meta's free operating cash‑flow deficit will reach $39 billion in 2026 and expand to $71 billion in 2027.
S&P warned that the massive outlays could keep Meta's free operating cash flow negative beyond 2028, and the company is expected to rely entirely on borrowing to fill the 2028 cash gap.

S&P said: "Given the still‑uncertain outlook for Meta's future capital spending and the multi‑year, aggressive AI investment plan, our confidence that Meta can control spending as previously expected has eroded."

A Meta spokesperson said: "We respect but disagree with S&P's view on Meta's AI monetization potential," adding that the company still sees "significant product and business opportunities" sufficient to support a very strong credit profile.
Meta's leverage ratio has risen from 0.1× in 2025, driven mainly by the company's choice to lease data‑center capacity rather than finance it through debt issuance, S&P noted.

S&P Global Ratings U.S. media and telecom sector head Naveen Sarma said: "If capital spending remains high and grows faster than we anticipate, corporate credit quality will continue to deteriorate and cash flow will stay negative."
As of September 30, Meta's long‑term debt stood at $80.92 billion.

S&P also downgraded Broadcom's (AVGO-US) credit outlook on Thursday from "Positive" to "Stable," noting that while its AI business is growing rapidly, operations are becoming more dependent on a few large customers.
Earlier this year S&P cut Oracle's (ORCL-US) credit rating to "BBB-," just one notch above non‑investment‑grade, due to an excessively leveraged balance sheet.

items.title: 晶片股提前迎「黑色星期五」英特爾等11個股10月跌逾20%
items.title_en: Chip Stocks Face an Early “Black Friday” as Intel and 10 Others Drop Over 20% in October
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，黑色星期五(Black Friday)通常落在11月底，但對晶片股而言，今年似乎提前了整整四週。光是10月，就有11檔半導體股票市值下跌逾20%，其中英特爾 (INTC-US) 跌幅最大，達45%。
然而，這波折價行情有個值得注意的地方。這11檔股票中，有10檔目前股價仍高於年初水準。即使經歷週五(30日)的暴跌，英特爾2026年以來的股價漲幅仍有74%。
華爾街眼前看到的究竟是真正的撿便宜機會，還是股價才剛開始反映基本面的調整？
英特爾釋警訊 晶片股回檔演變成全面出清
iShares半導體ETF (SOXX-US) 10月下跌16.5%，其中週五單日跌幅就達7.6%。
VanEck半導體ETF (SMH-US) 週五盤中重挫9%，在科技股帶動的整體市場賣壓下，股價跌破200日移動平均線，是2025年6月以來首見。
英特爾週五下跌近29%，市值蒸發約1,400億美元。公司預估第四季營收將落在150億至160億美元，低於華爾街預期的約170億美元。此外，公司預期PC晶片銷售額將較前一季下滑逾20%。
Trade Nation資深市場分析師David Morrison週五在一份報告中寫道：「第三季對超大規模雲端服務業者而言並不理想，這開始對AI相關股票造成沉重壓力。」
AI熱潮開始衝擊晶片產業其他領域
這波影響是透過記憶體市場傳導。記憶體製造商正將產能轉向供AI伺服器使用的高頻寬晶片，導致一般DRAM供應更加吃緊，價格也隨之上漲。
因此，筆記型電腦的製造成本提高，PC製造商也減少處理器訂單。同一波推升晶片產業某些領域的AI投資熱潮，反而正在削弱另一個領域的需求。
美銀分析師Vivek Arya週五將英特爾評級從「買進」下調至「中立」，並將目標價從145美元降至100美元，理由是「PC需求與供應方面的逆風，使轉型時程進一步延後」。
Cantor Fitzgerald分析師C.J. Muse則寫道：「休士頓，我們遇上麻煩了。」他將問題歸咎於記憶體、晶圓與基板短缺，並將目標價下調至90美元。他預估英特爾2027年每股盈餘為1.65美元，低於市場共識預期的2.13美元。
根據Benzinga Analyst Ratings追蹤的32位分析師，英特爾目前的整體評等為「中立」，平均目標價為104美元。
Cerebras Systems (CBRS-US) 股價下跌，因放空機構Culper Research指控，該公司的晶圓級AI晶片在實際部署環境中的使用壽命僅有1.5至2.5年。
聯電 (UMC-US) 第三季業績未達預期；Teradyne (TER-US) 則預估第四季營收大致持平。
不過，Muse仍看好Teradyne。他寫道，「請不要誤會，我們的研究仍支持SOC測試市場從目前水準開始，具有相當大的上漲空間。」
邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US) 週四重挫13.2%，此前有報導指出，該公司正與Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) 進行深入收購談判，交易可能採全股票方式進行，價值約830億美元。
英特爾的震撼消息也波及其他晶片股。Arm Holdings (ARM-US) 的設計架構應用於手機與筆記型電腦，股價下跌10.5%。Tower Semiconductor (TSEM-US)、Astera Labs (ALAB-US) 與Credo Technology Group (CRDO-US) 則下跌9%至12%。
半導體設備製造商科林研發 (LRCX-US) 與應用材料 (AMAT-US) 股價同步下跌。不過Arya認為，英特爾面臨的問題「對AI資料中心與半導體設備產業而言，反而是正面訊號，因為可能帶來額外的資本支出」。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Black Friday usually falls at the end of November, but for chip stocks this year it appears to have arrived a full four weeks early. In October alone, 11 semiconductor stocks saw market caps fall by more than 20%, with Intel (INTC-US) posting the steepest decline at 45%.

However, there is a noteworthy detail in this price‑cutting wave. Of the 11 stocks, 10 are still trading above their levels at the start of the year. Even after Friday’s (the 30th) plunge, Intel’s price since 2026 remains up 74%.
Wall Street wonders whether what it sees now is a genuine buying opportunity or merely the beginning of a price correction that reflects fundamentals.
Intel Issues Warning as Chip Stocks Retrace and Turn Into Broad Sell‑offs
The iShares Semiconductor ETF (SOXX-US) fell 16.5% in October, with Friday alone accounting for a 7.6% drop.
The VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH-US) slumped 9% during Friday’s session, and amid tech‑driven market pressure the price fell below its 200‑day moving average for the first time since June 2025.

Intel dropped nearly 29% on Friday, wiping about $140 billion off its market value. The company forecast Q4 revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, below Wall Street’s roughly $17 billion expectation, and said PC chip sales would decline more than 20% from the prior quarter.

Trade Nation senior market analyst David Morrison wrote in a Friday report: “Q3 was not ideal for the ultra‑large cloud service providers, and that is beginning to weigh heavily on AI‑related stocks.”
AI hype is now spilling over into other segments of the chip industry

The impact is being transmitted through the memory market. Memory makers are shifting capacity toward high‑bandwidth chips for AI servers, tightening supply of standard DRAM and pushing prices higher.

Consequently, laptop manufacturing costs have risen and PC makers are cutting processor orders. The same AI‑driven investment surge that is lifting certain chip sectors is simultaneously dampening demand in another area.

Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya downgraded Intel on Friday from “Buy” to “Neutral” and cut the price target from $145 to $100, citing “headwinds in PC demand and supply that further delay the transformation timeline.”

Cantor Fitzgerald analyst C.J. Muse wrote: “Houston, we have a problem.” He blamed shortages in memory, wafers and substrates and lowered his target price to $90. He projects Intel’s 2027 EPS at $1.65, below the consensus estimate of $2.13.
According to the 32 analysts tracked by Benzinga Analyst Ratings, Intel’s overall rating is currently “Neutral” with an average target price of $104.
Cerebras Systems (CBRS-US) saw its stock fall after short‑seller Culper Research alleged that the company’s wafer‑level AI chips have a service life of only 1.5‑2.5 years in real‑world deployments.
United Microelectronics (UMC-US) missed third‑quarter expectations; Teradyne (TER-US) projected roughly flat revenue for the fourth quarter.
Nonetheless, Muse remains bullish on Teradyne. He wrote, “Don’t get it wrong – our research still supports a sizable upside for the SOC test market from current levels.”
Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) tumbled 13.2% on Thursday after reports that it is in deep acquisition talks with Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) for a possible all‑stock deal valued at about $83 billion.

Intel’s shockwaves also hit other chip stocks. Arm Holdings (ARM-US), whose designs are used in phones and laptops, fell 10.5%. Tower Semiconductor (TSEM-US), Astera Labs (ALAB-US) and Credo Technology Group (CRDO-US) each slipped between 9% and 12%.

Semiconductor equipment makers Lam Research (LRCX-US) and Applied Materials (AMAT-US) saw their shares fall in tandem. Arya, however, believes Intel’s challenges are a “positive signal for AI data‑center and semiconductor‑equipment firms because they could spur additional capex.”

items.title: 小型股翻身時機到了？三大利多匯聚
items.title_en: Is It Time for Small-Cap Stocks to Turn Around? Three Major Bullish Factors Converge
paras: 美國大型科技股財報接連引發賣壓之際，美國小型股可望迎來翻身契機。《華爾街日報》週五 (30 日) 報導，隨著每年 11 月至隔年 4 月的股市傳統旺季到來、期中選舉不確定性即將消退，加上小型股在資金回流時漲勢往往較強，三項有利因素有望匯聚。
《華爾街日報》週五 (30 日) 報導，根據 Leuthold Group 統計，過去一個世紀，美國小型股在期中選舉年 11 月至隔年 4 月期間，平均總報酬換算成年化達 42%，與此前六個月年化虧損 4% 的表現形成鮮明對比。
報導指出，上一次小型股在這段期中選舉後的六個月期間未能上漲，得回溯至 1946 年。不過，42% 指的是六個月報酬換算後的年化數字，並非投資人在半年內平均賺取 42%。
報導分析，小型股的歷史強勢，來自三項因素交會：每年 11 月至隔年 4 月的股市傳統旺季、期中選舉落幕後的不確定性消退，以及小型股本身的規模效應。
其中，選舉結果揭曉帶來的釋然情緒，似乎比哪個政黨勝選更重要。無論政治結果如何，只要選舉塵埃落定，投資人便能減少對未知結果的顧慮，重新部署資金。
至於股市「最佳六個月」的季節性，並非美國獨有，其他市場也能觀察到類似現象。
一種解釋認為，這可能源自農業主導經濟時代的資金需求變化，包括春季播種與秋季收成帶來的季節性資金流動。
雖然「五月賣股離場」的投資俗諺，如今已不如過去可靠，但在期中選舉年的小型股表現上，這項季節性規律仍相當鮮明。
小型股對市場流動性較為敏感，也是漲勢容易放大的原因。夏季資金動能減弱，或投資人轉趨謹慎時，小型股往往承受較大賣壓。
反之，當新資金重新進場，小型股也可能出現更強勁的反彈。年初常見的「一月效應」，通常也以小型股最為明顯。
儘管近年市場焦點集中在超大型科技股，小型股的長期歷史成績仍有優勢。報導指出，依採用的指數不同，一個世紀前投入美國小型股的 1 美元，如今累積價值約為同期投入大型股標普 500 指數的五至六倍。
相較之下，近期大型科技股正面臨高估值考驗。Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 週四市值蒸發約 5,000 億美元，拖累美股表現
報導指出，當股價已反映近乎完美的成長預期，企業即使像亞馬遜一樣繳出符合預期的業績，也未必足以支撐股價。隨著期中選舉即將落幕，小型股能否重演歷史強勢，成為接下來半年值得關注的市場焦點。
paras_en: As earnings reports from large U.S. tech stocks trigger selling pressure, small‑cap stocks in the United States may be poised for a comeback. The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday (the 30th) that the traditional market “season” from November through April, the fading uncertainty of the midterm elections, and the tendency of small caps to rally strongly on capital inflows could all line up to benefit them.

The Wall Street Journal cited Leuthold Group data showing that over the past century, U.S. small‑cap stocks have delivered an average total return of 42% annualized during the November‑April window of midterm election years, a stark contrast to the 4% annualized loss recorded in the preceding six months.

The report notes that the last time small caps failed to rise in the six‑month post‑midterm period was back in 1946. However, the 42% figure is an annualized conversion of a six‑month return, not a claim that investors earn 42% in half a year.

The historical strength of small caps stems from three converging factors: the traditional November‑to‑April market season, the removal of uncertainty after the midterms, and the inherent size effect of small‑cap stocks.

The relief felt when election results are finally known appears to matter more than which party wins. Once the electoral dust settles, investors can let go of uncertainty about the outcome and redeploy capital regardless of the political winner.
The “best six months” seasonal pattern is not unique to the United States; similar phenomena can be observed in other markets as well.
One explanation points to the era of agriculture‑driven economies, when capital needs shifted with the planting season in spring and the harvest in autumn, creating seasonal cash flows.
Although the old investing adage “sell in May and go away” is less reliable today, the seasonal pattern remains pronounced for small caps in midterm election years.

Small‑cap stocks are more sensitive to market liquidity, which amplifies their moves. When summer capital momentum wanes or investors become more cautious, small caps tend to face heavier selling pressure.
Conversely, when fresh capital returns, small caps can rebound more vigorously. The “January effect” that often appears at the start of the year is typically most evident in small‑cap stocks.

Even though recent market focus has shifted to mega‑cap tech giants, small caps still enjoy a long‑term performance edge. Depending on the index used, a dollar invested in U.S. small caps a century ago would now be worth roughly five to six times the value of a dollar invested in the large‑cap S&P 500 over the same period.
By contrast, large‑cap tech stocks are currently confronting valuation challenges. Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) saw about $500 billion of market‑cap evaporate on Thursday, dragging down U.S. equities.

The report warns that once a stock price already reflects near‑perfect growth expectations, even companies like Amazon that deliver earnings in line with forecasts may not be able to sustain the price. With the midterm elections winding down, whether small caps can repeat their historical strength will be a key market focus for the next six months.

items.title: Siri終於有AI外援！蘋果牽手阿里千問 中國用戶11月搶先體驗
items.title_en: Apple Finally Gets an AI Ally! Apple Teams Up with Alibaba's Qwen; Chinese Users Can Try in November
paras: 蘋果正式宣布中國版Apple Intelligence即將推出，並與阿里巴巴 (Alibaba) (BABA-US)合作，將旗下AI模型「千問」整合至蘋果人工智慧服務。中國用戶最快11月4日起，可透過最新iOS開發者Beta版測試相關功能，預計12月隨iOS 27.3正式版推出。這也是Apple Intelligence自2024年推出以來，在中國市場取得的重要進展，蘋果希望藉由導入本地AI模型，進一步推動旗下裝置的人工智慧服務。
蘋果 (Apple) (AAPL-US) 10月31日公布，首波Apple Intelligence功能將整合千問的文字與圖像理解能力，讓中國用戶能直接在Siri、系統級寫作工具及視覺智能中使用千問，不必另外開啟獨立AI應用程式。這項合作將讓千問成為蘋果系統內可直接調用的AI服務之一，涵蓋問答、文件理解、圖像辨識及內容生成等應用。
在Siri方面，蘋果表示，當用戶提出特定問題時，Siri可以接入千問，利用其知識與理解能力提供協助。用戶也能透過Siri，針對自己選擇的照片、PDF文件及簡報內容提出問題，讓語音助理不再只處理簡單指令，也能協助理解文件及圖片資訊。若要使用千問，用戶必須登入千問帳戶，或選擇透過Apple帳戶登入。
在寫作工具方面，千問將整合進蘋果系統級寫作功能，提供「千問創作」(Compose with Qwen)服務。用戶可輸入主題或需求，直接生成原創文字內容，也能利用千問協助生成圖像。蘋果原有的寫作工具則提供改寫、校對及摘要功能，讓用戶能在不同應用程式中處理文字，不必將內容複製到其他AI平台。
視覺智能也是此次整合的重點。用戶可透過iPhone相機辨識眼前物體與場所，並選擇「詢問千問」進一步理解畫面內容，利用AI針對拍攝到的物品、環境或場景提出問題。用戶可透過相機控制、操作按鈕或控制中心啟用視覺智能功能。
阿里巴巴表示，千問整合功能將由用戶自行選擇是否啟用。使用者可以透過Apple登入，或使用既有千問App帳戶登入，在Siri、寫作工具及視覺智能中調用服務。當用戶準備將問題、文件或照片傳送給千問時，系統會先徵求同意，用戶也能自行決定何時使用千問，以及要分享哪些資訊。阿里巴巴並強調，用戶提出的請求及千問生成的回覆，都不會被用於模型訓練。
除了千問整合，蘋果也同步公布中國版Apple Intelligence首波功能，涵蓋即時翻譯、寫作工具、視覺智能、照片編輯及通知管理等多個面向。即時翻譯將整合在訊息、FaceTime及電話App中，協助用戶跨語言傳送訊息或進行通話，也支援透過AirPods 4、AirPods Pro 2及後續機型進行面對面對話翻譯。
照片App將新增「清除」工具，可移除照片中的干擾物件；自然語言搜尋則讓用戶透過文字描述尋找特定照片或影片，也能根據文字描述自動建立回憶影片。智繪表情功能則可依照用戶輸入的文字描述，生成符合情境的個人化表情符號。
寫作及通訊功能方面，蘋果將提供文字改寫、校對與摘要，並在郵件App中加入優先郵件分類，將較緊急的信件顯示在收件匣上方。郵件摘要可整理單封郵件或長篇郵件對話的重點，智能回覆則能在郵件及訊息App中提供快速回覆建議。
通知管理也將加入AI功能，包括通知摘要、首要通知及減少干擾專注模式。通知摘要可協助用戶快速掌握較長或分類堆疊的通知內容，首要通知則將較緊急的事項排在前面；減少干擾專注模式會過濾通知，只推送需要立即處理的訊息。
此外，備忘錄App中的錄音轉文字內容可自動生成摘要，電話通話的轉錄文字也能透過AI整理重要細節。Siri本身則將支援輸入文字進行對話，即使用戶表達不夠完整或連貫，也能理解其意圖，並在連續對話中維持上下文。
不過，這次推出的功能並不包含蘋果在2026年全球開發者大會 (WWDC)公布的下一代AI版Siri，以及其他新一代Apple Intelligence功能。此次主要是將既有Apple Intelligence功能導入中國市場，並透過千問補足部分AI問答、文字與圖像理解及內容生成能力。至於其他平台的支援，蘋果表示仍須取得必要審批後才會推出。
在適用範圍方面，千問整合功能將透過iOS提供，主要面向在中國購買支援Apple Intelligence的iPhone用戶，或裝置定位及Apple帳戶國家或地區設定均位於中國的使用者。相關功能將於11月4日起隨最新iOS開發者Beta版開放測試，預計12月隨iOS 27.3正式版向中國用戶推出。
蘋果此次與阿里巴巴合作，也反映其在中國市場推進生成式AI服務時，必須採取不同於美國及其他市場的策略。由於中國市場對生成式AI服務有不同的監管與審批要求，蘋果選擇與本地科技企業合作，將千問整合至既有作業系統，讓AI功能能在蘋果硬體及軟體生態系內提供。
對阿里巴巴而言，千問進入蘋果生態系，意味著其AI模型有機會接觸更廣泛的iPhone用戶，並透過Siri、寫作工具及視覺智能等高頻使用場景擴大服務觸及範圍。對蘋果而言，這項合作則有助於補強中國版Apple Intelligence的AI能力，降低因缺乏本地模型合作夥伴而延後推出服務的影響。
蘋果此次宣布的測試時程與功能範圍，代表中國版Apple Intelligence終於進入實際落地階段，但首波更新仍不包括下一代AI版Siri。後續能否依照規劃在12月推出正式版本，以及千問在蘋果生態系中的使用體驗與市場接受度，將成為觀察雙方合作成效的重要指標。
paras_en: Apple officially announced that a China-specific version of Apple Intelligence is coming, partnering with Alibaba (BABA-US) to integrate its AI model "Qwen" into Apple’s AI services. Chinese users can start testing the features via the latest iOS developer beta as early as November 4, with a full release expected in December alongside iOS 27.3. This marks a significant milestone for Apple Intelligence in China since its 2024 launch, as Apple aims to boost its device AI services by incorporating a local model.

Apple (AAPL-US) disclosed on October 31 that the first wave of Apple Intelligence features will embed Qwen’s text and image comprehension capabilities, allowing Chinese users to access Qwen directly through Siri, system‑wide writing tools, and visual intelligence without needing a separate AI app. The partnership makes Qwen one of the AI services callable within Apple’s ecosystem, covering Q&A, document understanding, image recognition, and content generation.

Regarding Siri, Apple said that when users ask specific questions, Siri can tap into Qwen, leveraging its knowledge and comprehension to assist. Users can also ask Siri about selected photos, PDFs, or presentation slides, enabling the voice assistant to go beyond simple commands and help interpret documents and images. To use Qwen, users must sign in with a Qwen account or choose to log in via their Apple ID.

For writing tools, Qwen will be integrated into Apple’s system‑wide writing features as a "Compose with Qwen" service. Users can input a topic or requirement to generate original text and can also use Qwen to help create images. Apple’s existing writing tools will continue to offer rewriting, proofreading, and summarization, allowing users to handle text across apps without copying content to external AI platforms.

Visual intelligence is another key focus of the integration. Users can point the iPhone camera at objects or places, select "Ask Qwen" to gain deeper insight into the scene, and pose AI‑driven questions about the captured items, environment, or context. The visual intelligence feature can be activated via camera controls, a dedicated button, or the Control Center.

Alibaba said the Qwen integration can be toggled on or off by users. They may sign in with Apple or use an existing Qwen app account to invoke the service in Siri, writing tools, and visual intelligence. When users are about to send a question, document, or photo to Qwen, the system will first request consent, letting users decide when to use Qwen and what information to share. Alibaba emphasized that user queries and Qwen‑generated replies will not be used for model training.

In addition to Qwen, Apple simultaneously unveiled the first set of China‑specific Apple Intelligence features, covering real‑time translation, writing tools, visual intelligence, photo editing, and notification management. Real‑time translation will be built into Messages, FaceTime, and the Phone app, helping users communicate across languages, and will also support face‑to‑face translation via AirPods 4, AirPods Pro 2, and future models.

The Photos app will gain a new "Remove" tool to eliminate unwanted objects from pictures; natural‑language search will let users find specific photos or videos by describing them in text and automatically create memory videos based on those descriptions. The "Intelligent Emoji" feature will generate personalized emojis that match a user’s textual prompts.

For writing and communication, Apple will offer text rewriting, proofreading, and summarization, and will add priority email sorting in the Mail app, surfacing more urgent messages at the top of the inbox. Email summarization can distill the key points of a single message or a long thread, while smart replies will suggest quick responses in Mail and Messages.

Notification management will also receive AI enhancements, including notification summarization, priority notifications, and a reduced‑distraction focus mode. Summaries help users quickly grasp the content of lengthy or stacked notifications; priority notifications push the most urgent items to the front; the focus mode filters notifications to only those that require immediate attention.

Additionally, the Notes app’s audio‑to‑text feature will automatically generate summaries, and transcribed phone calls can be processed by AI to extract important details. Siri itself will support typed input for conversations, allowing it to understand intent even when user phrasing is incomplete or fragmented, and to maintain context across multiple turns.

However, the rollout does not include the next‑generation AI‑powered Siri announced at Apple’s 2026 Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC), nor other upcoming Apple Intelligence capabilities. This effort mainly brings existing Apple Intelligence functions to China, supplementing them with Qwen for certain AI Q&A, text and image understanding, and content generation tasks. Apple noted that support for other platforms will await necessary regulatory approvals.

The Qwen integration will be delivered via iOS to iPhone users in China who have devices that support Apple Intelligence, or whose device location and Apple ID country/region settings are set to China. The features will be available for testing starting November 4 with the latest iOS developer beta and are slated for a December launch in the iOS 27.3 public release for Chinese users.

Apple’s partnership with Alibaba reflects the need for a different strategy in China’s generative‑AI market, which faces distinct regulatory and approval requirements compared to the U.S. and other regions. By collaborating with a local tech firm and embedding Qwen into its operating system, Apple can offer AI functionality within its hardware and software ecosystem while complying with Chinese rules.

For Alibaba, Qwen’s entry into Apple’s ecosystem means its AI model could reach a far broader iPhone audience and expand its presence through high‑frequency use cases like Siri, writing tools, and visual intelligence. For Apple, the deal helps shore up the AI capabilities of the China‑specific Apple Intelligence, mitigating delays that could arise from lacking a local model partner.

The announced testing timeline and feature scope indicate that the China version of Apple Intelligence is finally moving into real‑world deployment, though the first update still excludes the next‑generation AI Siri. Whether the full version launches as planned in December and how Qwen performs and is received within Apple’s ecosystem will be key metrics for gauging the success of the collaboration.

items.title: 經濟強、通膨高為何不升息？華許溝通失焦再傷Fed公信力
items.title_en: Why No Rate Hike Despite Strong Economy and High Inflation? Warsh’s Miscommunication Undermines Fed Credibility
paras: 聯準會 (Fed) 在經濟強勁、通膨仍高的情況下暫停升息，主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 卻未清楚說明等待的理由。《路透》專欄指出，華許雖承認金融條件已較先前收緊，卻未充分交代這些變化為何足以支持本次按兵不動，再度引發市場對 Fed 抗通膨決心的疑慮。
《路透》專欄作家 Jamie McGeever 週四 (29 日) 撰文指出，華許在 8 月底至 9 月中旬，一度讓金融市場重新相信，Fed 將堅守把通膨壓回 2% 的承諾。然而，週三 (28 日) 利率決策後的記者會，再次讓這份信心受到考驗。
Fed 本次維持聯邦基金利率目標區間於 3.75% 至 4.00%，未接續 9 月、亦即三年多來首次升息的步伐。與此同時，Fed 將經濟活動的描述由「穩健」上調為「強勁」，華許也承認，通膨仍然過高。
華許表示，9 月升息以來的六週，金融條件已略為收緊，但他同時強調，自己「不願、也無法」將目前的金融條件形容為緊縮。
這兩項說法並不矛盾：金融條件可以較先前收緊，卻仍未達到足以抑制經濟活動的程度。不過，McGeever 質疑，在通膨高於目標、經濟成長強勁、失業率偏低，金融條件又尚未緊縮的情況下，Fed 為何沒有再次升息？
多名記者在記者會上從不同角度追問，華許卻未提供足以讓投資人掌握政策邏輯的清楚解釋。他明確否認，本次決策受到下週期中選舉影響；McGeever 則解讀，華許的談話暗示 12 月升息的可能性偏高。
儘管華許重申，2% 是 Fed 唯一的通膨目標，他在記者會上多次提及「檢視現實」與「往窗外看」等說法，仍讓作者聯想到他在 7 月廣受批評的溝通表現。
Annex Wealth Management 經濟學家 Brian Jacobsen 表示，光靠言語無助於抑制通膨。McGeever 認為，當政策說明缺乏清楚內容時，這項問題尤其突出。
債市走勢也成為專欄關注的訊號。美國 2 年期與 10 年期公債殖利率利差週三擴大逾 6 個基點，創 7 月 29 日以來最大單日增幅。
此外，美國 10 年期損益兩平通膨率升至 2.38%，創六週新高，亦即回到 9 月 15 日以來最高水準。隔天，Fed 才一致通過三年多來首次升息決策。
殖利率曲線變陡，本身不足以證明 Fed 公信力下滑。不過，McGeever 將這項變化與損益兩平通膨率上升一併解讀，認為交易員正重新評估，華許領導的 Fed 是否願意採取必要政策，壓制已持續近六年高於目標的通膨。
華許原本已在修復市場信任方面取得進展。他在 8 月 28 日傑克森霍爾演說，以及 9 月 16 日會後記者會上，都曾緩解投資人對其抗通膨決心的擔憂。McGeever 形容，若先前是向前走了兩步，本次記者會便是退後一步。
專欄指出，華許的溝通問題除了表述不夠清楚，也在於他解釋聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 的集體決策時，往往未以代表整個委員會的方式發言，容易讓外界質疑內部缺乏共識。
官員對政策步調的分歧確實存在。7 月會議中，Fed 以 9 票對 3 票決議維持利率於 3.50% 至 3.75%，三名異議官員均主張升息，為 2016 年以來首次出現三張鷹派反對票。9 月，委員會一致通過升息；到了本次 10 月會議，則再度出現主張升息的異議聲音。
本次也是 2002 年以來，首次有 Fed 理事與地區聯準銀行總裁站在同一立場投下異議票；若僅計算雙方同時主張更緊縮政策的情況，則是 1990 年以來首見。
McGeever 認為，Fed 正面對能源價格高漲、人工智慧 (AI) 投資疑慮升溫，以及全球成長前景不明等挑戰。在這個敏感時刻，內部分歧與模糊的政策溝通，將使市場更難建立對 Fed 的信任。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve (Fed) has paused rate hikes despite a strong economy and persistently high inflation, yet Chair Kevin Warsh failed to clearly explain the reasons for waiting. A Reuters column notes that while Warsh acknowledges financial conditions have tightened compared with earlier, he did not sufficiently justify why those changes warrant holding steady, reigniting market doubts about the Fed’s anti‑inflation resolve.

Reuters columnist Jamie McGeever wrote on Thursday (the 29th) that Warsh briefly restored market belief in late August to mid‑September that the Fed would stay committed to pushing inflation back to 2%. However, the press conference after Wednesday’s (the 28th) rate decision again put that confidence to the test.

The Fed kept the federal‑funds target range at 3.75%‑4.00%, pausing the first hike in over three years that was slated for September. At the same time, the Fed upgraded its description of economic activity from “steady” to “strong,” and Warsh admitted inflation remains too high.

Warsh said that in the six weeks since the September hike, financial conditions have eased slightly, but he also stressed that he “does not want to, nor can he, describe the current financial conditions as tight.”

The two statements are not contradictory: conditions can be tighter than before yet still not restrictive enough to curb activity. Still, McGeever questions why the Fed did not raise rates again when inflation is above target, growth is robust, unemployment is low, and financial conditions are not yet tight.

Several reporters pressed Warsh from different angles at the press conference, but he offered no clear explanation that would let investors grasp the policy logic. He explicitly denied that the decision was influenced by next week’s midterm elections; McGeever interprets Warsh’s remarks as hinting a higher likelihood of a December hike.

Although Warsh reiterated that 2% is the Fed’s sole inflation goal, his repeated references to “checking reality” and “looking out the window” during the briefing reminded the author of his widely‑criticized communication in July.
Brian Jacobsen, an economist at Annex Wealth Management, said words alone do nothing to curb inflation. McGeever adds that the problem is especially acute when policy explanations lack clarity.
The bond market also provided a signal of concern. The spread between 2‑year and 10‑year Treasury yields widened by more than six basis points on Wednesday, the biggest single‑day jump since July 29.

In addition, the breakeven inflation rate for the 10‑year Treasury rose to 2.38%, a six‑week high and the highest level since September 15. The Fed would only approve its first rate hike in over three years the following day.

A steeper yield curve alone does not prove a loss of Fed credibility. However, McGeever reads the curve steepening together with the rising breakeven rate as traders reassessing whether a Warsh‑led Fed is willing to take the necessary steps to suppress inflation that has run above target for nearly six years.

Warsh had previously made progress in rebuilding market trust. His August 28 speech at Jackson Hole and the post‑meeting press conference on September 16 had eased investors’ concerns about his anti‑inflation resolve. McGeever describes the latest briefing as a step back after two steps forward.

The column points out that Warsh’s communication problems stem not only from unclear wording but also from his tendency to speak on FOMC decisions without representing the committee as a whole, prompting doubts about internal consensus.

Disagreements among officials do exist. In the July meeting, the Fed voted 9‑3 to keep rates at 3.50%‑3.75%, with three dissenters urging a hike—the first such trio of hawks since 2016. In September the committee unanimously approved a hike; in October the dissent resurfaced.

This October meeting also marked the first time since 2002 that a Fed governor and a regional bank president voted dissent together, and the first joint call for tighter policy since 1990 when counting both sides advocating more restriction.

McGeever believes the Fed now faces challenges from soaring energy prices, heightened AI investment concerns, and an uncertain global growth outlook. At this sensitive moment, internal splits and vague policy communication will make it harder for markets to build trust in the Fed.

items.title: 美股收盤｜AI投資回收疑慮升溫 那斯達克創6月來最大跌幅
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Close: AI Investment Return Concerns Rise, Nasdaq Posts Largest Drop Since June
paras: 2026年10月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股10月最後一個交易日賣壓沉重，投資人愈來愈擔心科技大廠持續擴大AI投資，能否帶來足夠回報。那斯達克綜合指數30日創6月以來最大單日跌幅，英特爾Intel(INTC-US)與社群平台Reddit(RDDT-US)均暴跌29%，先前受惠AI資本支出熱潮的晟碟Sandisk(SNDK-US)也下挫13%。
那斯達克100指數當日下跌3.5%，距離近期高點下跌10%的修正門檻已不遠。那斯達克綜合指數則較收盤高點回落7.8%，10月表現為2025年3月以來最差，先前靠AI題材累積的漲幅，也在這波下跌中回吐不少。
大型科技股本周接連走弱，微軟Microsoft(MSFT-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US)、亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)及Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，30日再跌1%至2%。這些公司持續投入資料中心與AI基礎建設，但支出規模愈來愈大，也讓投資人開始追問：投入的錢究竟何時能賺回來？
凱投宏觀統計，這四家公司過去12個月的資本支出，已占目前標普500指數成分股企業合計支出的三分之一以上，未來占比還可能提高。該機構市場經濟學家John Higgins指出，隨著這波投資開始部分仰賴外部融資，投資人對各家公司的投入金額，以及資金從哪裡來，都變得更加敏感。
Annex Wealth Management首席經濟策略師Brian Jacobsen表示，市場正重新判斷，哪些公司能靠這些投資賺到錢、哪些公司做不到。不過，Wedbush全球股票銷售與交易主管Sahak Manuelian認為，目前跌勢較像是先前漲多後的回檔，尚未看到特別嚴重的槓桿問題。只是股價先前漲得太快，一旦投資人開始撤出，跌勢也容易又急又深。
賣壓同時擴散至科技股以外的市場。高盛Goldman Sachs(GS-US)下跌4%，傑富瑞Jefferies(JEF-US)下跌6%；黃金與白銀分別下跌3.5%及6%，今年以來跌幅擴大至10%及31%。資金轉向美國公債避險，油價則上漲2%，讓原本就擔心美國經濟過度依賴AI投資的市場，再添一層疑慮。

paras_en: October 31, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The final trading day of October saw heavy selling pressure on U.S. equities, as investors grew increasingly worried whether large tech firms’ continued expansion of AI investment can deliver sufficient returns. The Nasdaq Composite fell its biggest single‑day drop since June on the 30th, with Intel (INTC‑US) and social platform Reddit (RDDT‑US) both plunging 29%, and Sandisk (SNDK‑US), which had previously benefited from the AI cap‑ex boom, sliding 13%.

The Nasdaq‑100 index fell 3.5% that day, bringing it close to the 10% correction threshold from recent highs. The Nasdaq Composite retreated 7.8% from its intraday peak, marking its worst October performance since March 2025, erasing much of the gains that had been built on AI‑related themes.

Large‑cap tech stocks weakened throughout the week, with Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US) and Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) each slipping another 1%‑2% on the 30th. These companies continue to pour money into data centers and AI infrastructure, but the growing scale of spending is prompting investors to ask when the money will be recouped.

According to KGI Macro Statistics, the capital expenditures of these four firms over the past 12 months now account for more than one‑third of total spending by S&P 500 constituents, and the share could rise further. Market economist John Higgins noted that as this wave of investment increasingly relies on external financing, investors are becoming more sensitive to how much each company is spending and where the funding is coming from.

Brian Jacobsen, chief economic strategist at Annex Wealth Management, said the market is re‑evaluating which companies can profit from these investments and which cannot. However, Sahak Manuelian, global head of equity sales and trading at Wedbush, believes the current decline looks more like a pull‑back after a strong rally, with no severe leverage issues yet evident. He added that the rapid price gains earlier made the stocks vulnerable to a swift and deep drop once investors start pulling out.

Selling pressure also spread beyond tech stocks. Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) fell 4% and Jefferies (JEF‑US) dropped 6%; gold and silver slid 3.5% and 6% respectively, widening year‑to‑date losses to 10% and 31%. Funds shifted into U.S. Treasury safe‑haven assets while oil prices rose 2%, adding another layer of concern for a market already wary of the U.S. economy’s heavy reliance on AI investment.

items.title: 盧比歐將與巴西外長會談！川普准波索納洛赴美避風頭升高美巴緊張
items.title_en: Rubio to Meet Brazil's Foreign Minister! Trump Sends Bolsonaro to U.S., Raising U.S.-Brazil Tensions
paras: 美國國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）與巴西外交部長已同意在未來幾週內舉行會談。知情人士表示，美國總統川普決定讓巴西落敗的右翼候選人弗拉維奧・波索納洛（Flávio Bolsonaro）赴美尋求庇護，引發兩國緊張關係升高，促成這次會談安排。
根據《彭博》報導，知情人士透露，盧比歐與維埃拉週五（30日）在亞特蘭大舉行的G20外長會議期間短暫會面，雙方同意在12月G20峰會登場前再次會談。
今年12月的G20峰會預計由川普在其名下的川普國家多羅高爾夫俱樂部（Trump National Doral Golf Club）主持。本週在喬治亞州舉行的部長級會議，旨在為這場峰會預作準備。
川普本週稍早批准波索納洛赴美。波索納洛在週日的巴西選舉中敗給左翼領袖、現任總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva），目前在巴西至少面臨兩項聯邦調查，涉及洗錢指控。
波索納洛獲美國國務院核發簽證後，週三宣稱將在美國領導反對魯拉的陣營，並指控選舉存在舞弊，但未提出任何證據。
川普表示，他之所以允許這名敗選候選人赴美，是因為巴西選舉「糟糕透頂」且「遭到操縱」，此外，他也強調自己「非常熟悉」波索納洛的父親、巴西前總統雅伊爾・波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）。
雅伊爾・波索納洛是川普的盟友，曾於2019年至2023年擔任巴西總統，目前因參與策劃政變未遂、企圖在2022年大選後阻止魯拉就任，而正在服刑，刑期為27年。
去年，美國曾對巴西實施強硬關稅措施，試圖協助雅伊爾・波索納洛避免入獄。此後，兩國關係一直起伏不定，儘管雙方在貿易方面已取得一些進展。
另一方面，巴西當局已召見阿根廷駐巴西最高外交代表，要求其說明阿根廷總統米雷伊（Javier Milei）在協助波索納洛逃離巴西一事中扮演的角色。波索納洛週二晚間越境前往鄰國阿根廷，隨後搭乘飛往美國的班機。

paras_en: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Brazil’s foreign minister have agreed to hold talks in the coming weeks, sources said. The move follows President Donald Trump’s decision to allow right‑wing candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who lost in Brazil, to seek refuge in the United States, heightening tensions between the two countries and prompting the meeting arrangement.

According to Bloomberg, sources said Rubio and Brazil’s foreign minister Vieira met briefly on Friday (the 30th) during the G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in Atlanta and agreed to reconvene before the G20 summit in December.
The December G20 summit is expected to be hosted by Trump at his Trump National Doral Golf Club. This week’s ministerial meeting in Georgia was intended to lay the groundwork for that summit.

Trump earlier this week approved Bolsonaro’s travel to the United States. Bolsonaro lost Sunday’s Brazilian election to left‑wing leader and incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and now faces at least two federal investigations in Brazil, including money‑laundering allegations.
After receiving a visa from the U.S. State Department, Bolsonaro said on Wednesday he would lead a U.S.‑based campaign against Lula and claimed the election was rigged, though he offered no evidence.

Trump said he allowed the defeated candidate to come to the U.S. because Brazil’s election was “a disaster” and “manipulated,” adding that he is “very familiar” with Bolsonaro’s father, former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro.

Jair Bolsonaro, a Trump ally who served as Brazil’s president from 2019 to 2023, is currently serving a 27‑year sentence for plotting a coup attempt and trying to block Lula’s inauguration after the 2022 election.

Last year the United States imposed tough tariffs on Brazil in an effort to help Jair Bolsonaro avoid prison. Relations between the two countries have since been volatile, though some trade progress has been made.

Meanwhile, Brazilian authorities have summoned Argentina’s top diplomatic representative in Brazil to demand an explanation of Argentine President Javier Milei’s role in helping Flávio Bolsonaro flee Brazil. Bolsonaro crossed into Argentina on Tuesday night before boarding a flight to the United States.

items.title: 亞馬遜未來支出承諾飆至8836億美元 新增800億美元融資額度支援AI擴張
items.title_en: Amazon’s Future Spending Commitment Soars to $883.581 Billion, Adds $80 Billion Financing Facility to Support AI Expansion
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US)在人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資持續擴大的同時，正面臨日益沉重的資金壓力。根據公司最新提交給美國證券交易委員會(SEC)的第三季文件，截至2026年9月底，亞馬遜未來合約支出承諾總額已攀升至8,835.81億美元，較前一季增加36%，更是2025年同期的兩倍以上。為支應資料中心及AI硬體採購，公司也新增最高800億美元的供應商融資貸款額度，進一步擴大籌資管道。
這項融資安排允許亞馬遜自行決定是否動用資金，期間自2027年第一季起至2028年第三季止，貸款期限則從每筆實際借款日起算，最長為5年，利率採浮動利率。作為擔保，亞馬遜將針對部分透過融資安排購買的資產提供擔保權益，相關未償還金額將列入公司資產負債表的長期債務。
不過，800億美元只是可使用的融資上限，並非亞馬遜已經借入的金額，公司也沒有承諾一定會動用全部額度。文件並未揭露具體哪些採購資產將作為擔保，也未公布參與貸款的金融機構及實際融資利率。
亞馬遜雲端運算部門Amazon Web Services (AWS)執行長馬特·加曼(Matt Garman)周五(30日)接受《彭博電視》訪問時表示，當公司看到眼前存在如此龐大的機會，就會尋找負責任的融資方式，以便盡可能擴大對客戶的服務規模。他也指出，隨著公司積極加速投資，亞馬遜正與合作夥伴研究如何平衡相關現金流。
過去，亞馬遜主要依靠雲端運算、零售等業務產生的營運現金流，以及大規模發行公司債，支應資料中心建設與晶片採購。此次新增供應商融資安排，則讓公司可以針對技術基礎設施採購取得額外資金，降低所有投資支出都由自身現金流承擔的壓力。

亞馬遜截至9月底的8,835.81億美元合約支出承諾，涵蓋範圍相當廣泛，並不等同於目前已經背負的有息債務，也不代表所有款項都必須在短期內支付。根據公司文件，這些承諾包括長期債務本金與利息2,942.54億美元、尚未開始的租約1,649.22億美元、不動產及設備採購承諾1,596.40億美元、營運租賃負債1,214.92億美元、無條件採購義務947.59億美元、融資租賃負債179.55億美元、融資義務115.65億美元，以及其他承諾189.94億美元。
其中，尚未開始的租約及不動產、設備採購承諾，反映亞馬遜為未來資料中心與技術基礎設施擴張所預留的資源。這些支出將隨著相關設施啟用及採購交付逐步轉化為實際付款義務，也使公司未來數年的資金需求更加龐大。
第三季財報進一步顯示，亞馬遜的AI投資已明顯推高資本支出。公司第三季現金資本支出達759億美元，遠高於2025年同期的342億美元；今年前9個月累計達1,722億美元，也大幅超過去年同期的899億美元。亞馬遜維持2026年全年現金資本支出約2,200億美元的預估，並預期2027年支出將進一步顯著增加，主要由技術基礎設施投資帶動。
資本支出快速增加，也使自由現金流由正轉負。亞馬遜截至2026年9月的過去12個月，自由現金流為負423.57億美元，與2025年同期正147.88億美元相比，減少約571億美元。同期營運現金流則由1,306.91億美元增加至1,683億美元，顯示核心業務仍持續創造現金，但設備與基礎設施投資的增幅更大，抵銷了營運現金流成長。
從資產負債表來看，亞馬遜截至9月底持有現金、約當現金及有價證券合計1,142億美元，低於2025年底的1,230億美元；長期債務則由去年底的656.48億美元升至1,731.25億美元，增加逾一倍。公司第三季營運現金流為424.22億美元，高於去年同期的355.25億美元，但大量資金仍持續投入資本支出及其他投資。
儘管現金流承受壓力，亞馬遜的雲端業務仍展現強勁成長。第三季AWS營收達459.84億美元，年增39%，高於去年同期的330.06億美元；營業利益則由114.34億美元升至177.73億美元。AWS營收成長速度加快，是亞馬遜持續擴大AI資料中心與技術基礎設施投資的重要支撐。
亞馬遜第三季合併營收為2,019.44億美元，年增12%；營業利益280.76億美元，高於去年同期的174.22億美元；淨利則為206.85億美元，略低於去年同期的211.87億美元。從業務結構來看，AWS營收占公司總營收比重已由去年同期的18%升至23%，雲端業務的重要性持續提高。
亞馬遜此次新增800億美元融資額度，反映AI基礎設施競賽已不只是技術與市場需求之爭，也逐漸成為資金調度及資產負債表管理的考驗。公司雖然仍擁有強勁的營運現金流，AWS成長也提供持續投資的商業基礎，但自由現金流轉負、長期債務攀升及未來合約支出承諾快速擴大，都意味著AI擴張需要更複雜的融資安排。
對投資人而言，關鍵不僅是亞馬遜能否持續擴建資料中心、取得晶片與運算資源，更在於這些投資能否轉化為足夠的AWS營收、營業利益及長期自由現金流。若AI需求持續強勁，龐大資本支出可能成為鞏固雲端市場地位的基礎；但若投資回收速度不如預期，快速增加的債務與長期支出承諾，也可能成為未來財務彈性的負擔。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is expanding its AI infrastructure investments while facing mounting financing pressure. According to the company’s latest third‑quarter filing with the U.S. SEC, as of the end of September 2026 the total amount of future contract spending commitments rose to $883.581 billion, up 36% from the prior quarter and more than double the level at the same time in 2025. To fund data‑center and AI‑hardware purchases, the company also added a new supplier‑financing loan facility of up to $80 billion, further widening its funding sources.

The financing arrangement allows Amazon to decide whether to draw down funds, covering the period from Q1 2027 through Q3 2028, with each loan’s term measured from the actual borrowing date and capped at a maximum of five years at a floating interest rate. As collateral, Amazon will grant security interests in certain assets purchased through the facility, and the outstanding amounts will be recorded as long‑term debt on the balance sheet.

However, the $80 billion is merely the ceiling of usable financing, not an amount already borrowed, and the company has not committed to using the full limit. The filing does not disclose which purchased assets will serve as collateral, nor does it name the lending institutions or the actual financing rates.

Matt Garman, chief executive of Amazon Web Services (AWS), told Bloomberg Television on Friday the 30th that when the company sees such a massive opportunity it looks for responsible financing methods to expand service capacity for customers as much as possible. He added that as Amazon accelerates its investments, it is working with partners to balance the related cash flows.

Historically, Amazon has relied on operating cash flow from its cloud and retail businesses and large corporate bond issuances to fund data‑center construction and chip purchases. The new supplier‑financing arrangement gives the company additional capital for technology‑infrastructure procurement, reducing the pressure of funding all investments solely from its own cash flow.

Amazon’s $883.581 billion contract‑spending commitment as of September‑end covers a broad range of items and is not equivalent to existing interest‑bearing debt, nor does it mean all amounts must be paid in the short term. The commitments include $294.254 billion of long‑term debt principal and interest, $164.922 billion of leases not yet commenced, $159.640 billion of real‑estate and equipment purchase commitments, $121.492 billion of operating lease liabilities, $94.759 billion of unconditional purchase obligations, $17.955 billion of finance‑lease liabilities, $11.565 billion of financing obligations, and $18.994 billion of other commitments.

The not‑yet‑commenced leases and real‑estate/equipment purchase commitments reflect resources set aside for future data‑center and technology‑infrastructure expansion. These expenditures will gradually turn into actual payment obligations as facilities are activated and deliveries made, further enlarging Amazon’s funding needs for the coming years.

The third‑quarter results show that Amazon’s AI investments have markedly lifted capital expenditures. Capital spending in Q3 reached $75.9 billion, far above $34.2 billion in the same quarter of 2025; for the first nine months of the year it totaled $172.2 billion, also well above $89.9 billion a year earlier. Amazon maintains its 2026 full‑year capital‑expenditure outlook of roughly $220 billion and expects 2027 spending to rise further, driven mainly by technology‑infrastructure investment.

The rapid rise in capex has turned free cash flow negative. Over the twelve months ending September 2026, Amazon’s free cash flow was a negative $42.357 billion, down about $57.1 billion from the positive $14.788 billion in the comparable 2025 period. Operating cash flow in the same span grew from $130.691 billion to $168.3 billion, showing the core business still generates cash, but the surge in equipment and infrastructure spending more than offsets that growth.

From the balance sheet, Amazon held $114.2 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at September‑end, down from $123.0 billion at the end of 2025. Long‑term debt rose from $65.648 billion at the end of last year to $173.125 billion, more than doubling. Third‑quarter operating cash flow was $42.422 billion, up from $35.525 billion a year earlier, yet large sums continue to be deployed to capex and other investments.

Despite cash‑flow pressure, Amazon’s cloud business remains strong. AWS revenue in Q3 was $45.984 billion, up 39% year‑over‑year, versus $33.006 billion a year ago; operating income rose from $11.434 billion to $17.773 billion. The accelerating AWS revenue growth underpins Amazon’s ongoing expansion of AI data centers and technology‑infrastructure spending.

Amazon’s consolidated Q3 revenue was $201.944 billion, up 12% year‑over‑year; operating income was $28.076 billion, higher than $17.422 billion a year earlier; net income was $20.685 billion, slightly below $21.187 billion in the prior year. AWS now accounts for 23% of total revenue, up from 18% a year ago, reflecting the growing importance of the cloud segment.

The new $80 billion financing facility highlights that the AI‑infrastructure race is no longer just about technology and market demand but also about capital allocation and balance‑sheet management. While Amazon still enjoys strong operating cash flow and AWS growth provides a solid investment base, the shift to negative free cash flow, rising long‑term debt and rapidly expanding contract‑spending commitments indicate that AI expansion will require increasingly complex financing structures.

For investors, the key question is not only whether Amazon can keep building data centers, securing chips and compute capacity, but also whether those investments translate into sufficient AWS revenue, operating profit and long‑term free cash flow. If AI demand stays robust, the massive capex could cement its cloud market position; however, if investment pay‑back lags, the swiftly growing debt and long‑term spending commitments could strain future financial flexibility.

items.title: OpenAI大砍募資目標100億美元！估值降至1.25兆美元、投資人縮減認購
items.title_en: OpenAI Slashes Funding Goal by $10 Billion, Valuation Cut to $1.25 Trillion as Investors Trim Commitments
paras: 人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮面臨市場重新評價之際，OpenAI傳出下修最新一輪募資目標，募資規模較原定計畫減少100億美元，目標估值也從1.4兆美元降至1.25兆美元。
根據《金融時報》週五（30日）引述知情人士報導，ChatGPT開發商OpenAI目前尋求募資約200億美元，並已設定週五為投資人承諾參與本輪募資的截止日。
不過，由於部分投資人縮減認購額度，預計首輪交割實際募得金額將低於200億美元。
《金融時報》補充，包含阿拉伯聯合大公國政府支持的科技基金MGX在內的一個阿聯投資人財團，預計將成為本輪募資的最大參與者。作為交易的一部分，OpenAI將取得選擇權，可租用該地區新開發的運算資源。
此外，創投機構Founders Fund、Coatue、紅杉資本（Sequoia Capital）及Andreessen Horowitz預計也將參與投資。
《金融時報》另指出，富裕個人投資者將有機會在後續的散戶發行計畫中，以1.25兆美元的估值投資OpenAI。
隨著市場對AI龐大支出的疑慮升高，美國科技股近期遭遇重挫。科技股比重較高的那斯達克指數週五下跌約2.9%，較10月6日創下的歷史收盤高點下跌7.8%。
《路透》先前報導，正計畫於2027年上市的OpenAI，積極尋求盡快完成本輪募資，部分原因是希望搶在Anthropic即將上市前完成交易，因為兩家公司鎖定的投資人群體相近。
paras_en: Amid a market re‑assessment of the AI investment boom, OpenAI has reportedly lowered its latest fundraising target, reducing the size of the round by $10 billion and cutting the target valuation from $1.4 trillion to $1.25 trillion.

According to the Financial Times on Friday (the 30th), which cited sources familiar with the matter, ChatGPT developer OpenAI is now seeking roughly $20 billion in funding and has set Friday as the deadline for investors to commit to the round.
However, because some investors are scaling back their subscriptions, the amount actually raised in the first closing is expected to fall short of the $20 billion target.

The FT added that a consortium of UAE investors, including the government‑backed technology fund MGX, is expected to be the largest participant in the round. As part of the deal, OpenAI will obtain an option to lease newly built compute capacity in the region.
In addition, venture‑capital firms Founders Fund, Coatue, Sequoia Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also slated to invest.
The FT also noted that wealthy individual investors will have the chance to invest in OpenAI in a later retail‑issuance program at the $1.25 trillion valuation.

As concerns grow over the massive spending required for AI, U.S. tech stocks have recently taken a sharp hit. The Nasdaq, which is heavily weighted toward tech, fell about 2.9% on Friday, a 7.8% drop from the all‑time closing high set on October 6.

Reuters previously reported that OpenAI, which plans to go public in 2027, is pushing to close this round quickly, partly to complete the transaction before Anthropic’s upcoming IPO, since the two companies target largely overlapping investor bases.

items.title: 商用PC換機需求仍在 漲價考驗明年採購量 華碩逆勢增加市占
items.title_en: Commercial PC Replacement Demand Persists, Price Hikes Test Next Year's Procurement, ASUS Expands Market Share Against the Tide
paras: 2026年10月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 戴爾Dell(DELL-US)、惠普HP(HPQ-US)及華碩ASUS(2357-TW)積極搶攻商用PC換機潮，但記憶體等零組件漲價，也讓企業採購面臨預算壓力。三家業者各有布局，戴爾鎖定高階商用機種爭取市占，惠普靠調價與產品組合支撐營收，華碩則維持出貨成長，在漲價壓力下逆勢擴大商用PC市占。
戴爾認為，既有設備老舊及Windows 11升級需求，仍是支撐商用換機的主要動能。公司截至2025年10月底的2026會計年度第三季，商用業務營收年增5%，商用需求連續七季成長。面對後續市場出貨壓力，戴爾將著重高階商用產品，並運用供應鏈優勢爭取市占。
惠普則出現營收增加、出貨減少的情況。2026會計年度第三季商用PC營收年增22%，出貨量卻減少14%，主要靠調整售價及提高高階產品比重支撐。即使如此，個人系統事業營益率仍較去年同期下降0.8個百分點至4.6%，零組件成本增加持續侵蝕獲利。
相比之下，華碩在這波漲價壓力下，商用PC市占反而持續擴大，出貨已連續六季年增逾50%。相較惠普透過漲價與產品組合維持營收成長，華碩有實際出貨量增加作為支撐，商用業務基期較低，也提供較大的擴張空間。
不過，華碩同樣面對客戶預算限制。華碩表示，今年下半年國內PC價格已上漲約10%，部分機構原先編列的預算已買不齊所需設備，必須重新安排採購。換機需求雖然還在，但實際能買多少台、採用什麼規格，仍受預算限制。
宏碁也指出，上半年台灣商用PC表現不如預期，企業預算尚未完全到位，加上政府標案因調整規格而延後，影響出貨進度。第四季可望隨企業與政府機關消化年度預算帶動採購，但部分客戶已拉長設備使用年限，後續換機步調仍有變數。
展望2027年，華碩仍看好台灣商用PC市場量價齊揚。今年下半年政府與大型企業採購已較積極，部分半導體製造商也開始洽談明年需求。為因應設備漲價，部分企業與政府機關正考慮增加明年預算，以完成既定換機計畫。

paras_en: Dell (DELL-US), HP (HPQ-US), and ASUS (2357-TW) are aggressively targeting the commercial PC replacement wave, but rising prices for components such as memory are putting budget pressure on corporate purchasing. Each company has its own strategy: Dell focuses on high‑end commercial models to capture market share, HP relies on price adjustments and product mix to support revenue, and ASUS maintains shipment growth, expanding its commercial PC market share against the price‑pressure trend.

Dell believes that aging existing equipment and the need to upgrade to Windows 11 remain the main drivers for commercial replacement. By the end of October 2025, in the third quarter of its 2026 fiscal year, Dell’s commercial business revenue grew 5% year‑over‑year, with commercial demand growing for seven consecutive quarters. Facing future shipment pressure, Dell will focus on high‑end commercial products and leverage its supply‑chain advantage to win market share.

HP has experienced a situation of revenue growth but shipment decline. In the third quarter of its 2026 fiscal year, HP’s commercial PC revenue grew 22% year‑over‑year, while shipments fell 14%, mainly supported by price adjustments and a higher proportion of high‑end products. Even so, the personal systems business margin fell 0.8 percentage points to 4.6% compared to the same period last year, as component costs continue to erode profitability.

In contrast, ASUS has seen its commercial PC market share continue to expand under the price‑pressure wave, with shipments growing more than 50% year‑over‑year for six consecutive quarters. Unlike HP, which maintains revenue growth through price increases and product mix, ASUS has actual shipment growth to support its commercial business, which started from a lower base and therefore offers greater expansion space.

However, ASUS also faces customer budget constraints. ASUS stated that domestic PC prices have risen about 10% in the second half of the year, and some institutions find that their previously allocated budgets are insufficient to purchase the required equipment, forcing them to rearrange procurement. While replacement demand still exists, the actual number of units that can be purchased and the specifications used remain limited by budget.

Acer also noted that commercial PC performance in Taiwan was below expectations in the first half of the year, as corporate budgets have not yet fully materialized, and government tenders were delayed due to specification adjustments, affecting shipment schedules. The fourth quarter is expected to see procurement driven by the absorption of annual budgets by enterprises and government agencies, but some customers have extended equipment lifespans, so the pace of future replacements remains variable.

Looking ahead to 2027, ASUS remains optimistic about the volume and price of Taiwan’s commercial PC market. In the second half of the year, government and large enterprises have become more proactive in procurement, and some semiconductor manufacturers have begun to discuss next‑year demand. To cope with equipment price increases, some enterprises and government agencies are considering increasing next year’s budget to complete their planned replacement programs.
